t: 孤独是被挑选的布景
te: Solitude Is a Chosen Set
a: 把空旷拍成美，先得有人替你清场
ae: To photograph emptiness as beauty, someone first clears the room for you.

t: 共情不是bug，是他们的敌人
te: Empathy Is Not a Bug. It's Their Target.
a: 把共情说成漏洞，是为了让谁都不必再被看见。
ae: Calling empathy a glitch is how you make sure no one has to be seen again.

t: 国歌不是国歌，是库存
te: The Anthem Is Inventory
a: 把国家做成歌单，是文化暴力最便宜的一次投放
ae: Turning a country into a playlist is cultural violence's cheapest drop.

t: 死者被做成一面旗
te: They Made a Dead Man Into a Flag
a: 他们用他的死打一场他生前没参加过的仗。
ae: They used his death to fight a war he never joined.

t: 把世界观挪进支线，就算修好了吗
te: Moving Lore to Side Quests Isn't a Fix
a: 节奏是结果，不是原因；改尺子不等于改能力。
ae: Pacing is a symptom, not a cause. Changing the ruler isn't changing the ability.

t: 股价涨了8%，账单还没寄出
te: Shares Up 8%, Bill Not Yet Mailed
a: 算力写在财报里，代价写在谁的肺里。
ae: The compute goes in the earnings report; the cost goes in someone's lungs.

t: 谁有资格讲创伤
te: Who Gets to Tell the Wound
a: 把历史暴力拍成奇观，是最省力的赦免
ae: Turning historical violence into spectacle is the cheapest way to grant absolution.

t: 计票要几天，解释权只要一句
te: Counting Takes Days; Naming the Winner Takes One Sentence
a: 谁有资格宣布结果，比结果本身更值钱
ae: Who gets to declare the result is worth more than the result.

t: 淘汰的是最会看的人
te: The One Who Saw It All Got Voted Off
a: 她被淘汰，因为她把判断力攥在自己手里
ae: She was eliminated for keeping her own judgment

t: 档案搬了家，解释权没搬家
te: The Archives Moved. The Power to Interpret Didn't.
a: 谁被写进档案，谁就被写进事实；谁只留下横幅，谁就只配当注脚。
ae: Whoever gets written into the archive gets written into fact; whoever leaves only a banner gets a footnote.

t: 省下的钱不会变成内容
te: The Savings Won’t Become Content
a: 裁员的成本被记在员工账上，节约的收益被记在增长账上
ae: The cost of the cuts lands on workers; the benefit lands on growth.

t: 当《蝇王》沦为一张概念图
te: Lord of the Flies, Now a Concept Art Spread
a: 被抽掉政治的《蝇王》，正好拿来装饰商品
ae: A story about how civilization eats its weakest, repackaged as a paint job.

t: 皇后再婚，版权不换手
te: The Empress Remarries, the IP Doesn't
a: 提前一天不是礼物，是给订阅数的止痛片
ae: A one-day early release isn't a gift. It's a painkiller for subscriber numbers.

t: 一首歌赢过一次，代价还在
te: They Won Once, and Still Pay the Price
a: 她们赢了那场博弈，也从此付了定价。
ae: They won that fight, and got priced for it ever after.

t: 停火生效后的一千五百九十三条命
te: 1,593 Dead Under a Ceasefire
a: 「停火」是给战争改的名字，不是战争的结束
ae: A 'ceasefire' is a new name for a war, not the end of one.

t: 换一副嗓子，换一个角色
te: A New Voice, A New Character
a: 声音不是配件，是角色存在的一部分
ae: A voice isn't an accessory. It's part of how a character exists.

t: 观众疲劳是收视下滑的替罪羊
te: Viewer Fatigue Is the Alibi for a Ratings Slide
a: 把流失说成疲劳，是给解释权打的一针麻药
ae: Calling lost viewers tired is a sedative for the people who own the narrative.

t: 两个男人，一片海，没有女人
te: Two Men, One Ocean, No Women
a: 把男性身体当耗材，再把它拍成荣耀
ae: Treat a man's body as fuel, then film it as glory.

t: 披风飞了，领舞没飞
te: The Cape Flew, the Lead Didn't
a: 她抢的不是领舞位，是表达的定价权
ae: What she seized wasn't the lead, it was the right to price her own expression.

t: 选票换不了定价权
te: A Ballot Can't Buy Pricing Power
a: 被投票的永远是解释权，不是政策
ae: What gets voted on is never policy. It's who owns the facts.

t: 省下的油钱不算赢
te: Saving Fuel Isn't Winning
a: 对冲是给华尔街看的，省油才是给自己活的
ae: Hedging is for Wall Street; burning less is for yourself

t: 居留权按收入定价，护理工豁免是补丁
te: Residency Priced by Income, Care Worker Exemption Is a Patch
a: 定居权被明码标价，护理工豁免只是把伤口贴上一块胶布
ae: Settlement rights now come with a price tag; the care worker exemption is a bandage on a wound.

t: 战争账单从不寄给开战的人
te: The War Bill Never Goes to the People Who Start It
a: 375亿是首付，剩下的由每户人家分期付。
ae: $37.5 billion is a down payment. Households pay the rest in installments.

t: 一个孩子的死，被算成了政治账
te: A Child's Death, Booked as a Political Cost
a: 疫苗覆盖率跌到95%以下，不是天灾，是有人拆的墙。
ae: Vaccination coverage below 95% is not a natural disaster. It is a wall someone tore down.

t: 1998 年的谷歌是件道具
te: Google's 1998 Is a Prop
a: 可切换的怀旧，是给无法退回的现实打的蜡。
ae: Switchable nostalgia is wax polished onto a reality you can't return to.

t: AI的钱从哪来，谁在付
te: Who Pays for the AI Bill
a: 债务装不下的时候，他们开始卖股权
ae: When debt can't hold it, they start selling equity.

t: 2600万的婚礼前奏
te: The $26 Million Prelude
a: 用钱买来的善意，定价权还在他们手里
ae: Kindness with a price tag still has its price set by the donor.

t: 红毯上的反抗，谁在定价
te: Who Prices the Rebellion on the Red Carpet
a: 把反景观的戏服穿成景观，这就是回收。
ae: Wearing an anti-spectacle costume as a spectacle is called recycling.

t: 四十五天的暂停，买不到解释权
te: Forty-Five Days Buys No Say
a: 禁令暂停的是施工，不是定价权。
ae: The moratorium pauses construction, not the pricing power.

t: 谁在给未来定价
te: Who Prices the Future
a: 价格目标是一种叙事，不是事实。
ae: A price target is a narrative, not a fact.

t: 清醒是一种可以被讲述的人设
te: Sobriety Was a Persona She Could Narrate
a: 她把戒酒讲成了人设，人设一立，复饮就变成了私事。
ae: She turned sobriety into a persona, and a persona turns a relapse into a private matter.

t: 音乐工业把菜单换成了座位表
te: The Music Industry Swapped the Menu for a Seating Chart
a: 谁坐上餐桌，谁就负责给人定价。
ae: Whoever takes a seat at the table gets to set the price on everyone else.

t: 改姓不是八卦，是表达
te: A Surname Is a Receipt
a: 姓是父系私有制的收据，退回收据就是一次退出
ae: A surname is the patriarchy's receipt; handing it back is an exit.

t: 你是谁，这个问题是武器
te: "Who Are You" Is a Weapon
a: 问「你是谁」的人，手里已经握着解释权
ae: Whoever asks "who are you" already holds the power to define

t: 不脱，是她的定价权
te: Not Undressing Is Her Pricing Power
a: 她说「可怕」，说的是这个行业给女体的定价。
ae: When she says "terrifying," she is naming the industry's price tag on women's bodies.

t: 蛋糕粉进Target，卖的是妈妈人设
te: Target Sells the Mom, Not the Mix
a: 她不是在卖蛋糕粉，是在卖一个能进Target的妈妈。
ae: She isn't selling cupcake mix. She's selling a mother Target can shelve.

t: 公主的门票是身体
te: The Ticket to Princesshood Is the Body
a: 她守住的不是纯洁，是定价权。
ae: She isn't protecting purity. She's protecting her price.

t: 十八个点的仁慈
te: Eighteen Percent of Mercy
a: 他不制造暴力，他只是给暴力算了个利率
ae: He didn't invent the violence. He just put an interest rate on it.

t: 死者有基础病，奶牛没有
te: The dead had conditions; the cows didn't
a: 风险被写成「低」，代价写在一个人的病历上。
ae: Risk is written as "low"; the cost is written on one person's chart.

t: 把封面排成榜，把女人排成货
te: Rank the Covers, Price the Woman
a: 一张封面被定价的时候，定价的从来不只是封面。
ae: When a cover gets ranked, it's never just the cover being priced.

t: 西德妮回归，谁在定价
te: Sidney Returns. Who Sets the Price?
a: 她赢回的是一次涨价，不是定价权
ae: She won a raise, not the power to set her price.

t: 明星的票，投给谁
te: Whose Vote Does a Rock Star Cast?
a: 背书是表达武器，不是选票本身
ae: An endorsement is a weaponized expression, not a ballot.

t: 总统的纪念碑，纳税人买单
te: The President's Monuments, Paid by Taxpayers
a: 他建的不是纪念碑，是给自己定价的收据。
ae: He isn't building monuments. He's building receipts that price him.

t: 他给产妇的账单标了价
te: He Put a Price on Mothers
a: 追债追到逮捕，是结构暴力借了法律的手
ae: Debt collection that ends in arrest is structural violence borrowing the law's hand

t: 一部电影的立项名单里没有故事
te: A Greenlight List With No Story On It
a: 立项名单很长，故事只有一句
ae: The credits are long; the story is one sentence.

t: 英雄堕落早被写好了
te: The Hero's Fall Was Already Written
a: 救世主故事的价值不在英雄，在他倒下之后谁接管叙事
ae: A messiah story's worth isn't the hero — it's who takes over the narrative after he falls.

t: 倒戈的民主党人比对手更诚实
te: The Defector Is More Honest Than Her New Ally
a: 她不投他，因为她知道他会赢
ae: She didn't back him because she thought he'd lose

t: 片酬谣言背后是定价权
te: The Rumor Is the Pricing Mechanism
a: 她不是被低估，她是被定价。
ae: She wasn't underpaid. She was priced.

t: 打给选民看，不是打给伊朗看
te: Struck for the Voters, Not for Iran
a: 一场「防御性」打击，防的是选票流失。
ae: A "defensive" strike that defends the ballot count.

t: 十四年婚姻，一张改名申请
te: Fourteen Years, One Name Change
a: 她把姓氏改回去，是这场离婚里最锋利的一行字。
ae: Taking her name back is the sharpest line in the filing.

t: 进步派明星的免罪券
te: The Progressive Star's Indulgence
a: 他敢说种族灭绝，却不敢说出自己剧的名字
ae: He'll say genocide, but not the name of his own show

t: 他倒下之后，枪口还没放下
te: The Guns Stayed Up After He Went Down
a: 「他转身举枪」是一句叙事，尸检报告是另一句
ae: "He turned and pointed a gun" is a narrative. The autopsy is a fact.

t: 她说中了，然后没信
te: She Nailed It, Then Let It Go
a: 真话摆在面前，被当成玩笑收走
ae: The truth was handed over and filed as a joke.

t: 换把尺子，就叫民主化
te: A New Ruler, Renamed Democracy
a: 把内部工具下放叫民主化，是把词用错了地方
ae: Calling an internal tool rollout democracy is just borrowing the word.

t: 谁有资格算乡村
te: Who Gets to Be Country
a: 分类不是描述，是发证
ae: A category is not a description. It is a license.

t: 被运走的身体，被留下的舞
te: Bodies Shipped Away, Dances Left Behind
a: 移走的是人，留下的是谁在解释这段离散
ae: People were moved; the question is who gets to explain the dispersal

t: 把选民做成流量池
te: Turning Voters Into a Traffic Pool
a: 他们学会的不是组织，是操作。
ae: They didn't learn organizing. They learned operations.

t: 罢工被编成芭蕾，屠宰场编成梦
te: The Strike as Ballet, the Slaughterhouse as Dream
a: 工人身体的痛，被搬上舞台之后还剩下多少
ae: Once the workers' pain is staged, how much of it is left?

t: 用海峡换解除封锁
te: Trading a Strait for a Blockade
a: 谈判桌上的每一方都在给别人的身体定价。
ae: Everyone at the table is pricing someone else's body.

t: 裁员裁到大动脉，飞轮还在转
te: The Flywheel Spins Because Someone Gets Thrown Off
a: 飞轮转得动，是因为有人被甩出去了
ae: The flywheel still spins — that's what a flywheel does to the people it throws off.

t: 1400万的池子，和一场选举
te: A $14m Pool and an Election
a: 用一座池子团结国家，等于承认没有别的能团结。
ae: To unite a country with a reflecting pool is to admit nothing else will.

t: 防御性打击，这个词本身就是武器
te: "Defensive Strikes" Is Itself the Weapon
a: “防御”是开火方给自己贴的标签，不是事实。
ae: "Defensive" is a label the side pulling the trigger gives itself. It is not a fact.

t: 用同意令买下认知入口
te: Buying the Interface, One Consent Decree at a Time
a: 反垄断审查不是刹车，是定价。
ae: Antitrust review isn't a brake. It's a price.

t: 加息治通胀，代价不问人
te: Rate Hikes Treat Inflation, Not the People Paying
a: 利率是刀，握刀的手从不出现在伤口旁边
ae: The hand holding the knife never appears beside the wound

t: 合法的抢劫，不叫丑闻
te: Legal Robbery Is Not a Scandal
a: 他迟报 240 天，规则只让他改个日期。
ae: He filed 240 days late; the rule only made him fix a date.

t: 尖叫女王回来了，票价谁定
te: The Scream Queen Is Back. Who Sets the Price?
a: 她的回归被定价，她的身体从来没被定价。
ae: Her return gets priced. Her body never did.

t: 选举不是被买走的，是被定价的
te: Elections Aren't Bought, They're Priced
a: 谁出钱，谁就在给「事实」定价
ae: Whoever pays is pricing what counts as fact

t: 神坛上的女性，还是货架上的女性
te: Goddesses on a Pedestal, or Women on a Shelf
a: 把女神一个个请下神坛，再一个个摆上货架。
ae: They take the goddesses off the altar one by one, then put them on the shelf one by one.

t: 足球的激情，谁在付账
te: Who Pays for the Passion
a: 被歌颂的狂热，是别人付了命的生意。
ae: The frenzy being celebrated is a business someone else paid for with their life.

t: 监视者被写成守护天使
te: The Watcher as Guardian Angel
a: 把监视者拍成守护天使，是在替监视洗白
ae: Making the Stasi man a guardian angel is how surveillance gets a good name.

t: 她不是背叛，是替你被裁员
te: She Didn't Betray You. She Replaced Someone.
a: 你对机器失望，机器背后是省掉的人
ae: Your disappointment at the machine is really about the person it removed.

t: 只认钱的赏金猎人又来了
te: Another Bounty Hunter Who Only Follows the Money
a: 同一个剧本换个频道，照样有人买单。
ae: Same script, different channel. Someone still pays.

t: 民主AI的枪管
te: The Barrel of Democratic AI
a: 「民主AI」是新的文明叙事，出口的是解释权。
ae: 'Democratic AI' is the new civilization story; what it exports is the power to define.

t: 一集舒服的情景喜剧，和它不肯承认的事
te: A Comfortable Sitcom And The Thing It Won't Say
a: 「没有真正的冲突」不是缺点，是这部剧的商业模式。
ae: "No real conflict" isn't a flaw here. It's the business model.

t: 她打赢了怪物，没打赢定价
te: She Beat the Monsters, Not the Price Tag
a: 战斗做得再好，也遮不住她被做成了卖点
ae: Great combat can't hide that she was built as the selling point

t: 一张选票，一场私人恩怨
te: One Ballot, One Personal Vendetta
a: 解释权不在投票的人手里，在讲故事的人手里。
ae: The power to explain beats the power to vote.

t: 兄弟重聚，署名只有一个
te: Two Brothers Reunite, One Name Directs
a: 两个人写的剧本，导演栏只站得下一个人。
ae: Two people wrote the script; the director's chair fits one name.

t: 好爸爸人设挡不住五百万
te: A Good Dad Story Doesn't Stop $5 Million
a: 他们不否认他施暴，只说他是个有瑕疵的人
ae: They don't deny the violence. They call him a flawed human.

t: 谁在给舞台定尺寸
te: Who Gets to Size the Stage
a: 商标法被请来给一场戏改台词，这才是真侵权。
ae: Trademark law was invited to line-edit a play. That's the real infringement.

t: 免费证件照，付费的叙事
te: A Free Headshot, a Paid Narrative
a: 赞助商买下的不是电影，是「谁在讲故事」的解释权。
ae: The sponsor isn't buying films. It's buying the right to define who gets to tell stories.

t: 五千人死了，药还没批
te: Five Thousand Dead, No Drug Approved
a: 病死率超过50%，不是因为病毒太强，是因为这里的人命不值钱。
ae: A death rate above 50 percent is not because the virus is strong. It is because these lives are cheap.

t: 木偶戏不是怀旧，是定价
te: A Puppet Show Isn't Nostalgia. It's Pricing.
a: 怀旧是最好卖的表达，因为它的账没人查。
ae: Nostalgia is the best-selling expression because nobody audits its books.

t: 「T值太低」是在给谁量体温
te: Who's Holding the T Meter
a: 把对手说成不够男人，是元暴力最省力的一次续费。
ae: Calling your opponent not man enough is meta-violence renewing its lease, cheaply.

t: 一场没有人谈人的选举
te: An Election Where Nobody Counts the People
a: 选票在数钱，不在数人的死活。
ae: The ballots count money, not bodies.

t: 圣诞歌不欠谁一个圣诞
te: A Christmas Song Owes No One a Christmas
a: 全女阵容和捐款是真的，圣诞单曲是生意。
ae: The all-female lineup and the donations are real. The Christmas single is business.

t: 关掉法院，暴力就合法了
te: Shut the Courts, and Violence Becomes Legal
a: 关闭法院不是维稳，是给暴力发许可证。
ae: Closing courts is not stability. It is a license for violence.

t: 炸弹落下时，人道是开战理由
te: The Bombs Knew When People Would Arrive
a: 把领取救济的人当作目标，是最诚实的战争宣言
ae: Targeting people collecting aid is the most honest declaration of war.

t: 生孩子的代价没有写进采访
te: The Cost of a Baby Isn't in the Interview
a: 他说自己还是个孩子，没人问另一个孩子由谁照顾。
ae: He says he's still a kid. Nobody asks who's raising the other one.

t: 谁在背叛，谁在定义背叛
te: Who Betrays, Who Defines Betrayal
a: 「温和」是标签，「背叛」是判断，两样都是解释权的产物。
ae: "Moderate" is a label. "Betrayal" is a judgment. Both are products of who holds the naming rights.

t: 撞断腿的是车，不是法律
te: The Car Broke His Leg, Not the Law
a: 暴力的第一层从来不需要解释权，只需要一辆车。
ae: Direct violence needs no explanation—only a vehicle.

t: 一个制片人死了，众筹替他付葬礼
te: A Producer Died. GoFundMe Is Paying for the Funeral.
a: 十六年制造笑声的人，死后要靠众筹回家。
ae: Sixteen years of making people laugh, and he needs crowdfunding to get home.

t: 一本回忆录，两个共谋者
te: A Memoir, Two Co-conspirators
a: 女人互删，男人替她出手——这就是共谋的分工
ae: Women erase each other; a man steps in for her—that's the division of labor.

t: 自研引擎是自由，也是账本
te: A Custom Engine Is Freedom, and Also a Ledger
a: 独立工作室的浪漫，是资本缺席时自己垫上的风险
ae: The romance of the indie studio is the risk it absorbs when no capital shows up.

t: 十句话术，卖的是顺从
te: Ten Phrases, Priced to Obey
a: 所谓亲和力，是把听话包装成美德，再按份出售
ae: Approachability is obedience repackaged as a virtue and sold by the phrase.

t: 葬礼要靠众筹的粘合剂
te: The Glue Who Needed a GoFundMe for His Funeral
a: 他被叫做粘合剂，粘合的是别人的家庭
ae: They called him the glue. He was holding up someone else's family.

t: 偶像的真诚也是产品
te: Idol Sincerity Is Also a Product
a: 练习生的合约在暗处，成长的故事在明处。
ae: The contract stays in the dark; the growing-up story goes on sale.

t: 换一个标签，同一场围猎
te: A New Label, the Same Hunt
a: 攻击他的宗教，和攻击他反犹，是同一件事的两个步骤。
ae: Attacking his religion and calling him antisemitic are two steps of one operation.

t: 断网是账单，不是事故
te: The Outage Was an Invoice
a: 谁握着开关，谁就握着主权
ae: Whoever holds the switch holds the sovereignty.

t: 换党不换暴力
te: A New Party, the Same Machine
a: 选举换的是人，不是那台机器
ae: Elections change the people, not the machine.

t: 二十年了，她还是他的注脚
te: Twenty Years On, She's Still His Footnote
a: 他的「tell-all」里，她的身体还是被讲述的素材
ae: His tell-all still uses her body as material to be narrated.

t: 他讲藻类，因为藻类听话
te: He Talked About Algae Because Algae Don't Talk Back
a: 当现实不配合，就换一个自己能赢的现场。
ae: When reality won't cooperate, pick a stage where you can declare victory.

t: 断网逼单，战争成了订阅生意
te: The Subscription That Decides a War
a: 把一国的防空卖给订阅套餐，这不是断网，是定价。
ae: Selling a nation's air defense as a subscription upgrade isn't an outage. It's a price tag.

t: 复刻版保住了一款烂游戏
te: The Remaster Kept a Bad Game Alive
a: 复刻的意义不是翻案，是让烂游戏照样活着
ae: A remaster's job isn't redemption; it's letting a bad game keep existing

t: 棒球外交，谁在写剧本
te: Baseball Diplomacy Writes Its Own Script
a: 「外交」两个字，替谁抹掉了账本
ae: The word 'diplomacy' hides the ledger

t: 八美元买不回定价权
te: Eight Dollars Doesn't Buy You Pricing Power
a: 定价权在平台手里，玩家只是被通知折扣。
ae: The platform sets the price; the player is only notified of the discount.

t: 阿纳金是他们的假最优解
te: Anakin Is Their Fake Optimal Expression
a: 他们不是在扮演反派，是在给自己找一个能输得体面的剧本
ae: They aren't cosplaying a villain. They're casting one to lose with dignity.

t: 冰人换了一张脸，别的没变
te: A New Face for Iceman, Same Old Temperature
a: 选角新闻里没有受害者，只有一套从1963年没动过的定价方式。
ae: No one is hurt in a casting story. That's exactly why it shows how the pricing works.

t: 富豪交税不是慈善，是欠账
te: A Billionaire's Tax Is a Debt, Not a Gift
a: 让富豪自愿交税，本身就是暴力的证据
ae: Letting billionaires volunteer their taxes is itself evidence of violence

t: 国家安全挡不住排气管
te: National Security Can't Cap a Smokestack
a: 换尺子换不掉涡轮机，法官没上当
ae: Changing the ruler doesn't change the turbine; the judge didn't buy it.

t: 更年期不是段子，是墙
te: Menopause Is Not a Punchline. It's a Wall.
a: 把绝经写成尿路感染的段子，是定价权的胜利，不是女性的。
ae: Turning menopause into a UTI joke is a win for whoever gets to price the story, not for women.

t: 股市不投票，它只定价
te: The Market Doesn't Vote, It Prices
a: 把选举换算成收益率，是把政治变成天气
ae: Turning an election into a rate of return turns politics into weather.

t: 民调算得出票，算不出谁在付账
te: Polls Can Count Votes, Not Who Pays
a: 民调测量不满，不测量不满被谁定价。
ae: Polls measure discontent, not who sets its price.

t: 奥斯卡季是一门排期生意
te: The Oscar Race Is a Scheduling Business
a: 奖项不是艺术裁判，是发行窗口的定价权。
ae: Awards aren't art's referee; they're pricing power over release windows.

t: 游戏没出，谜语先卖了四年
te: Four Years of Selling the Riddle, Not the Game
a: 悬念不是叙事，是提前上市的一种商品。
ae: Mystery isn't narrative here; it's a product shipped years early.

t: 投票站不是被砍，是被定价
te: The Poll Tax Is Now Measured in Miles
a: 把投票站搬远，就是给选票加价。
ae: Move the polling place far enough, and you've put a price on the ballot.

t: 池子是他的，票是你的
te: The Pool Is His, the Vote Is Yours
a: 当叙事只剩池子，票就被当成池水
ae: When the pitch is a pool, the vote is treated as water.

t: 油价跌了，仗还没打完
te: Oil Fell. The War Didn't.
a: 谈判是选举前的道具，油价替它标了价。
ae: The talks are a prop for the midterms. The oil price is the receipt.

t: 「选择国家而非仇恨」的定价权
te: The Pricing Power of "Country Over Hate"
a: 先把人定义成威胁，再谈宽容。
ae: First define a people as a threat, then talk about tolerance.

t: 道歉的人拿到了四集
te: The Man Who Apologized Got Four Episodes
a: 他道歉时说的是「系统」，转身就把系统做成了自己的新专辑宣传物料。
ae: He said "a system" in his apology, then turned the system into his own promotional material.

t: 八五折卖的是游戏，八五折卖的是人
te: The 85% Off Is on Games, and on You
a: 定价权在谁手里，谁就定义什么是「值得拥有」
ae: Whoever sets the price also decides what counts as worth having.

t: 百老汇缺的不是明星
te: Broadway Doesn't Need Another Star
a: 明星救票房，救不了没人写得出的话
ae: A star sells tickets; it can't write the songs nobody can write.

t: 一场善意，一次撤退
te: A Kindness, A Retreat
a: 退到口罩后面的人，还在被定价。
ae: The person behind the mask is still being priced.

t: 九条命，与一句「我们没时间了」
te: Nine Lives, and One Line: We're Out of Time
a: 「有经验的飞行员」是叙事，不是事实。
ae: 「Experienced pilot」 is a narrative, not a fact.

t: 民调不是选票，别急着庆祝
te: Polls Aren't Ballots. Don't Celebrate Yet.
a: 把抽样误差讲成科学，是另一种武器化
ae: Selling sampling error as science is its own weaponization.

t: 十亿美元的镜头语言
te: A Billion-Dollar Camera Angle
a: 补贴的是制片公司的账本，不是那五万个失业的人。
ae: The subsidy goes to studio ledgers, not to the 50,000 who lost jobs.

t: 停车场不是突袭的豁免区
te: A Parking Lot Is Not a Raid Exemption Zone
a: 当暴力机器借用地皮，地皮的主人就是下一个靶子
ae: When the violence machine borrows your land, the landowner becomes the next target.

t: 反腐查到她为止
te: The Probe Stopped at Her
a: 钱买得动，法律买得断
ae: Money buys access; power buys impunity.

t: 规则终于追上他了
te: The Rules Finally Caught Him
a: 他失去的不是权力，是制造现实的能力
ae: What he lost wasn't power. It was the ability to manufacture reality.

t: 九枚炸弹落在避难的人群上
te: Nine Bombs on the People in the Shelter
a: 人道二字在战争里从来不是护身符
ae: Humanitarian is never a shield in war, only a target worth calculating

t: 十五分钟也能被续费
te: Even Fifteen Minutes Can Be Renewed
a: 走红不是被看见，是被定价。
ae: Going viral isn't being seen. It's being priced.

t: 换一张脸，换不掉那套叙事
te: A New Face Doesn't Change the Story
a: 选角新闻不是没有政治，是政治被包装成了没有。
ae: Casting news isn't apolitical. The politics is just packaged as none.

t: 摇滚明星的站台不算选票
te: A Rock Star's Endorsement Is Not a Vote
a: 名人背书是表达武器，不是选票
ae: Celebrity endorsement is a weapon of expression, not a ballot.

t: 道歉的形式你来定，账单我来定
te: You Shape the Apology, We Set the Bill
a: 道歉可以谈，钱不能谈——这就是定价权。
ae: Apologies are negotiable; money is not. That is who holds the pricing power.

t: 倒影池修得再好，也不投票
te: A Renovated Pool Doesn't Vote
a: 他修的是池子，卖的是「一切尽在掌握」的观感
ae: He fixed the pool; he's selling the feeling that everything is under control.

t: 邦德换人，换的从来不是人
te: Bond Recasts the Man, Never the Machine
a: 选谁演007是幌子，谁有权定义「最佳」才是真问题
ae: The question was never who plays 007. It is who gets to define "best."

t: 王后的沉默也是一种表达
te: The Queen's Silence Is Also an Expression
a: 她不是陪衬，她是共谋者中最安静的那一个。
ae: She is no sidekick. She is the quietest co-conspirator in the room.

t: 五十岁的爱情不是剧情，是定价
te: At Fifty, Love Isn't a Plot, It's a Price
a: 「她感觉着往前走，尽量不显得太脆弱」——这句话是整篇采访里最诚实的一句。
ae: "She's feeling her way, trying not to be too vulnerable" is the most honest line in the whole interview.

t: 仇恨是他们的最后一张选票
te: Hate Is Their Last Ballot
a: 当政策拿不出来，他们就开始卖偏见。
ae: When the policy well runs dry, they sell prejudice instead.

t: 先制造「非法选民」，再收割恐惧
te: Manufacture the «Illegal Voter», Then Harvest the Fear
a: 投票权被削掉的那部分，从来不是从投票日开始的。
ae: The voting rights being stripped away were never taken on Election Day.

t: 五十年传统，剩一块外墙
te: The Tradition Survives. The Wall Doesn't.
a: 奖项还在，解释权已经换手。
ae: The award is intact. The right to speak for it has changed hands.

t: 抢卡的人比卡更值钱
te: The Cards Are Worth More Than the People Who Steal Them
a: FBI 在给卡店装警报，却没问一张纸片凭什么值一辆车。
ae: The FBI is installing panic buttons for cardboard while nobody asks why a piece of paper costs a car.

t: 全女公社，是出口还是陷阱
te: An All-Female Commune Is a Hole, Not an Exit
a: 全女公社是男权世界让出的一个洞，不是出口。
ae: An all-female commune is a hole the patriarchal world left open, not an exit.

t: 外交是私事，账户也是
te: Foreign Policy as a Family Business
a: 当外交变成家务事，被卖掉的从来不是账户，是人。
ae: When diplomacy becomes a family matter, what gets sold is never the account. It's people.

t: 她拿到了署名，然后砸了那座桥
te: She Got the Credit, Then Burned the Bridge
a: 作者拿到控制权的那一刻，控制权就开始反过来控制她。
ae: The moment an author wins control, control starts winning over her.

t: 进步派的席位，不是解释权
te: A Seat Is Not the Ruler
a: 换掉议员，不等于换掉尺子。
ae: Swapping representatives is not swapping the ruler.

t: 把名字刻上去，不等于留下来
te: A Name Carved In Is Not a Name That Stays
a: 控制你抬头看见什么，就是权力本身。
ae: Control what people see when they look up: that is power itself.

t: 六周复工，不是励志故事
te: Six Weeks Back Is Not a Comeback Story
a: 她把没有产假说成美国常态，这句话本身就是控诉。
ae: Calling no maternity leave "normal" is itself the indictment.

t: 一张假名单，一次真试探
te: A Fake List, a Real Probe
a: 选举争议不是事实之争，是谁有权定义事实的争夺。
ae: Election fights aren't about facts. They're about who gets to define them.

t: 分手通稿里没有她
te: The Breakup Statement Has No Her in It
a: 「共同决定」是最省事的一种叙事
ae: "Mutually agreed" is the cheapest narrative available.

t: 当官方的车成为凶器
te: When the State's Car Becomes the Weapon
a: 定义谁在施暴的人，往往就是施暴的人。
ae: Whoever defines who is violent is usually the one being violent.

t: 谁在为谁背书
te: Who Is Endorsing Whom
a: 背书的人换了阵营，登记代理人没换雇主。
ae: The endorser switched sides; the registered agents kept their employer.

t: 一个制片人的死，被写成了一场表演
te: A Producer's Death, Staged as a Tribute
a: 悼词越动人，越说明活着时没人替他兜底
ae: The more moving the eulogy, the clearer nobody had his back while he was alive.

t: 没有销售员的公司，卖的是什么
te: A Company With No Salespeople, Selling What Never Needed Selling
a: 卡普说没有销售员，可他卖的东西从来不需要销售员。
ae: Karp says he has no sales force. What he sells never needed one.

t: 投票率一高，就成了罪证
te: High Turnout Is Now Evidence of a Crime
a: 「反向种族主义」是给投票权上的新锁
ae: 'Reverse racism' is a new lock on the right to vote

t: 选票在替谁记账
te: Who Pays for the Seats He Cleared
a: 他清掉的不是对手，是自己党的席位。
ae: He didn't clear rivals. He cleared his own party's seats.

t: 倒计时卖的是期待
te: The Countdown Is the Product
a: 没有内容的倒计时，本身就是内容
ae: A countdown with no content is the content.

t: 未来是门票，不是能力
te: The Future Is a Ticket, Not a Capacity
a: 换掉尺子的发布会，从来不缺舞台
ae: A launch that swaps the ruler never lacks a stage

t: 恐龙的血，和尺子的血
te: Dinosaur Blood and the Blood of Rulers
a: 换一把尺子，就能宣布一个世界第一
ae: Change the ruler, and you can declare a world first.

t: 上市可以撤回，代价不撤
te: The Listing Withdrew, the Cost Stayed
a: 撤回的是上市，留下来的是被定价的人。
ae: The IPO was pulled; the people it was priced on were not.

t: 「混乱的中间」是谁的中间
te: Whose Middle Is the Messy Middle?
a: 说极化是错觉的人，先定义了什么叫极端。
ae: Before you call polarization an illusion, you define what counts as extreme.

t: 她不是叛徒，她是共谋者
te: She's Not a Traitor, She's a Co-conspirator
a: 党派的忠诚叙事遮住了真正的站队：钱和解释权
ae: Party loyalty talk hides the real line: money and the power to explain.

t: 歧视是动员令，也是筛子
te: Bigotry Is a Turnout Tool and a Filter
a: 他们不是在攻击他的信仰，是在给「谁算美国人」定价。
ae: They aren't attacking his faith. They're pricing who counts as American.

t: 以色列成了他们的照妖镜
te: Israel Is Their Mirror
a: 钱能买席位，买不到解释权
ae: Money buys seats, not the right to define what happened

t: 毒物和毒贩睡一张床
te: The Poisoned Sleep With the Poisoners
a: 他们不是没看见毒，是毒贩替他们买了单。
ae: They didn't miss the poison. The poisoners paid for their silence.

t: 「失控」是形容词，不是分析
te: "Out of Control" Is an Adjective, Not an Analysis
a: 把政治暴力说成某个人的脾气，是在替制造它的结构免责
ae: Calling political violence a man's temper is how the structure that produces it gets off the hook.

t: 电先断，人后死
te: Cut the Power First, the Dead Come Later
a: 先炸变电站，是让死亡显得像意外
ae: Bombing substations makes death look like an accident

t: 把居留权按工资定价
te: Residency Priced by Payslip
a: 定居权被拆成工资单上的数字，谁付得起谁才算扎根。
ae: Settlement is now a number on a payslip: pay enough and you belong.

t: 迪士尼乐园不需要署名
te: The Magic Kingdom Doesn't Need Credits
a: 神秘感是品牌资产，署名是劳工权利。
ae: Mystery is a brand asset. A credit is a labor right.

t: 不审核，也是一种定价
te: No Moderation Is Also a Price Tag
a: 他卖的不是写作，是解释权的一份股权
ae: He isn't selling writing. He's selling equity in the right to explain.

t: 他连一池水都要重新定义
te: He Even Has to Redefine a Pool
a: 当现实不配合，就宣布现实是蓄意破坏
ae: When reality won't cooperate, declare reality vandalism

t: 数字创作者进了董事会
te: The Digital Creator Joins the Board
a: 他演的是贪财牧师，签的是平台合同
ae: He plays a greedy preacher; he signs the platform's contract.

t: 把解释权装进屏幕墙
te: The Wall That Explains Itself
a: 他们卖的不是数据，是谁有权说数据是什么意思。
ae: They aren't selling data. They're selling the right to say what data means.

t: 「我一生都是那场试镜」
te: My Whole Life Has Been the Audition
a: 他十二岁就选定了自己，四十八岁才拿到那个角色。
ae: He chose himself at twelve and got the part at forty-eight.

t: Meta 买了饥饿游戏的痛感
te: Meta Buys the Hunger Games' Pain
a: 反乌托邦被做成噱头，痛感变成卖点。
ae: A dystopia becomes a gimmick; the pain becomes the selling point.

t: 明星替烂片挡刀
te: Stars Take the Bullet for a Flop
a: 神坛上的片子摔了，先怪写影评的人
ae: When the sacred film falls, blame the people who write about it.

t: 机器人不投票，它替你决定
te: The Bot Won't Vote. It Will Decide for You.
a: 聊天机器人不是顾问，是新的解释权入口。
ae: A chatbot is not an adviser. It is a new gate to interpretation.

t: 别让富豪上桌，也别让散户接盘
te: Stop the IPOs, Keep the Casino
a: 文章替普通人喊停 IPO，却没问谁被允许坐上赌桌。
ae: The piece names the risk correctly, then hands the bill to the wrong people.

t: 选票的成色由谁定义
te: Who Gets to Decide a Ballot Counts
a: 谁有权宣布一张选票不算数，谁就握着解释权
ae: Whoever can declare a ballot invalid holds the power to define the outcome.

t: 抽签不是公平，是换个方式排队
te: A Lottery Is Just a Queue With Better Manners
a: 抢不到的人和黄牛之间，只多了一道抽签
ae: Between the fan who loses and the scalper, there is now one extra draw.

t: 把偶像装进玻璃柜，再卖一杯酒
te: Put the Idol in a Glass Case, Then Sell a Drink
a: 博物馆卖的不是文物，是一次被许可的亲近。
ae: A museum sells not artifacts but a licensed intimacy.

t: 城市翻倍，机会给谁
te: Doubling Cities, Priced for Whom
a: 「私人投资的机会」是这份报告里唯一被定价的东西。
ae: The only thing this report prices is the "opportunity" itself.

t: 假宗教发真魔法，谁在付账
te: A Fake Religion, Real Magic, and Who Pays
a: 邪术师的规则被改写：权力归了发牌的人，代价归了签字的人。
ae: The warlock rules changed: power goes to the one dealing the cards, the cost to the one signing.

t: 一场肥皂剧，替谁挡住了账单
te: A Soap Opera That Covered the Bill
a: 她不是背叛了党，她是回到了给她付钱的那一边
ae: She didn't betray the party. She went back to the side that paid for her.

t: 童星不是人设，是产能
te: A Child Star Is Not a Persona, It's Capacity
a: 她不是在告别角色，是在从流水线上下来
ae: She wasn't leaving a role. She was stepping off an assembly line.

t: 一部关于赎罪的好笑剧集
te: A Very Funny Show About Redemption
a: 被除名的人想回名人堂，这才是最好笑的地方
ae: The funniest thing here is a banned man asking the same league to let him back in

t: 五角大楼的AI喇叭
te: The Pentagon's AI Megaphone
a: 它不制造事实，它制造「什么是事实」
ae: It doesn't manufacture facts. It manufactures what counts as fact.

t: 和平协议碎了，医院先塌
te: The Peace Deal Broke; the Hospitals Fell First
a: 停火签在纸上，炸弹落在营地上。
ae: Ceasefires are signed on paper. Bombs land on camps.

t: 三趴人开盘，全民当先知
te: Three Percent Sets the Odds
a: 群体智慧是招牌，定价权在三趴人手里。
ae: "Wisdom of the crowd" is the sign; three percent holds the pricing power.

t: 一句公道话的定价权
te: Who Gets To Re-Judge The Oscars
a: 四十年前的输赢，今天还得由他盖章
ae: Forty years on, the verdict still needs his signature.

t: AI短剧霸榜，观众被喂了什么
te: AI Microdramas Top the Charts. What's Being Fed to Viewers?
a: 当生产成本被压到零，被压缩的是人的表达。
ae: When production cost hits zero, what gets compressed is human expression.

t: 公开住址不是把桌子摆平
te: Publishing Home Addresses Is Not Leveling the Field
a: 他们能拿走的只有隐私，拿不走的是权力
ae: They can take privacy. They cannot take power.

t: 礼物清单在给谁定价
te: Who the Gift Guide Is Pricing
a: 一份礼物清单，就是一张表达价目表。
ae: A gift guide is a price list for expression.

t: 选票不是清算，是止损
te: A Ballot Is Damage Control, Not Reckoning
a: 把共谋者选下去，只是换掉执行者，解释权还在原地。
ae: Voting out the enforcers leaves the interpretive monopoly untouched.

t: 承诺选举，不等于交出解释权
te: A Promise of Elections Is Not a Handover of the Power to Define Them
a: 没有日期的选举，是一张不写金额的支票
ae: An election without a date is a cheque with no amount written on it.

t: 九条命换一条谣言
te: Nine Lives for One Rumor
a: 死亡是事实，名字是噪音
ae: The dead are facts; the names are noise.

t: 她的子宫，他们替她做主
te: Her Womb, Their Decision
a: 医生跟丈夫商量，不跟她商量——这就是元暴力。
ae: The doctor consulted the husband, not her. That is meta-violence.

t: 700部小说的入口，不是作品
te: 700 Novels Is a Catalog, Not a Hurdle
a: 改编的难题被说成体量，体量正是它的卖点。
ae: The difficulty is described as scale; the scale is the selling point.

t: 赔率不是选票
te: Odds Are Not Votes
a: 把政治变成赔率，是把解释权卖给开赌场的人。
ae: Turning politics into odds sells the right to interpret to whoever runs the casino.

t: 石油换算力，谁在给谁定价
te: Oil for Compute, and Who Prices Whom
a: 融资的尽头是主权基金，算力的尽头是石油。
ae: Funding ends in sovereign wealth; compute ends in oil.

t: 法官读得懂日历
te: The Judge Can Read a Calendar
a: 「武器化」这个词，今天被用在了它真正的意思上
ae: Today "weaponization" was used to mean what it actually means.

t: 法官看见了日历，没看见共谋
te: The Judge Read the Calendar, Not the Conspiracy
a: 被驳回的是案子，不是那套叙事。
ae: What was dismissed was the case, not the narrative.

t: 圣诞女王加冕，谁在收税
te: The Christmas Queen Collects Rent
a: 一首歌的纪录，是几十年造出来的收租权。
ae: A song's chart record is a decades-built right to collect rent.

t: 凶器是车，罪名是袭击
te: The Weapon Was the Car
a: 车是新的枪，罪名是新的谎。
ae: The car is the new gun. The charge is the new lie.

t: 一场零射正的胜利，谁被定价了
te: A Clean Sheet, and Who Gets to Price It
a: 球场上没有中立的事实，只有被讲述的事实。
ae: There are no neutral facts on a pitch, only narrated ones.

t: 品味是最便宜的阶级墙
te: Taste Is the Cheapest Class Wall
a: 他卖的不是相机，是一张盖过章的口味证明。
ae: He isn't selling a camera. He's selling a stamped certificate of taste.

t: 一只断手，和它不该说的话
te: A Severed Hand, and the Things It Shouldn't Have Said
a: 万圣节最吓人的不是断手，是幕后花絮里漏出的剧透。
ae: The scariest part of Halloween isn't the severed hand. It's the spoiler in the BTS footage.

t: 预测市场给选民定价
te: Prediction Markets Price the Voter
a: 赔率不是民意，是庄家给民意定的价。
ae: Odds are not public opinion. They are the bookmaker's price on it.

t: 左手给右手的AI雄心
te: The Left Hand Funds the Right
a: 换尺子不换能力，账面上的多元化。
ae: A new ruler, not a new capability.

t: 五百本护照换不来一次问责
te: Five Hundred Passports, Zero Consequences
a: 公民身份不是墙，是筛子，筛孔由执法者临时决定。
ae: Citizenship isn't a wall. It's a sieve, and the agents decide the mesh size on site.

t: 二十分钟，和一个女孩的鸟
te: Twenty Minutes, and a Girl's Bird
a: 把人赶出家门，再让他们自己收拾残局
ae: Drive people out of their homes, then let them clean up the mess.

t: 赌财报的人，赌的不是公司
te: The Earnings Bet Is Not a Bet on the Company
a: 定价权在谁手里，谁就不必解释自己。
ae: Whoever sets the price never has to explain himself.

t: 数据中心先到，选票后到
te: The Data Center Arrives Before the Ballot
a: 居民赢了禁令，但土地还在开发商手里。
ae: They won a moratorium. The developer still owns the land.

t: 让选民耐心，是门老手艺
te: Patience Is Charged to the People Who Pay
a: 「耐心」是向被定价的人收的第二笔钱
ae: "Patience" is a second bill sent to those already paying.

t: 劝架的人手里没有牌
te: The Ones Urging Peace Hold No Cards
a: 海湾国家在谈和平，因为决定权不在他们手上。
ae: The Gulf talks peace because the decision isn't theirs to make.

t: 把庄园修复成风景
te: Restoring the Plantation Into Scenery
a: 技术修复的是画质，不是叙事。
ae: The restoration fixes the picture, not the narrative.

t: 不让你就座，也是一种暴力
te: Not Seating You Is Also Violence
a: 他们不打算赢下辩论，只打算取消对手的座位。
ae: They don't plan to win the argument. They plan to cancel the seat.

t: 扒手的手，照护者的手
te: The Pickpocket's Hands, the Caretaker's Hands
a: 教他偷钱包的是一双手，教他撑住一个家的也是。
ae: One pair of hands taught him to steal; another taught him to hold a family together.

t: 蝙蝠侠的反派靠模具泄露
te: Batman's Villains Leaked Through a Prosthetic Hand
a: 连反派都要靠玩具模具来官宣，这就是IP的定价权
ae: Even the villain gets announced by a toy mold. That's IP pricing power.

t: 输掉参议院也要清理门户
te: They'd Rather Lose Than Be Told
a: 他们怕的不是输，是选民不听话。
ae: They don't fear losing. They fear voters who won't obey.

t: 赦免是货，价钱谈崩了
te: The Pardon Was For Sale; the Cut Wasn't His
a: 他骂的不是腐败，是抽成没到他账上。
ae: He's not angry about corruption. He's angry the cut didn't reach his account.

t: 十年计划，一年一本的幻觉
te: A Ten-Year Plan Dressed Up as Speed
a: 产能叙事是出版业最成功的武器化包装
ae: Productivity narrative is publishing's most successful weaponized packaging.

t: 自信女王卖的是你的孤独
te: The Confidence Queen Sells Your Loneliness
a: 约会内容做成生意，代价由谁付。
ae: Dating content is a business. Ask who pays.

t: 圣诞歌不圣诞，是门生意
te: A Christmas Song That Isn't About Christmas
a: 节日歌单是情感入口，也是定价权
ae: Holiday playlists are an emotional entry point, and someone holds the pricing power.

t: 一撇胡子值一篇报道
te: One Mustache, One Full Article
a: 当权力穿上戏服，媒体只负责量袖长
ae: When power puts on a costume, the press only measures the sleeve

t: 换把尺子，收你一笔税
te: Change the Ruler, Charge Them a Tax
a: 定价权在谁手里，谁就不必解释自己的尺子
ae: Whoever owns the ruler never has to explain it.

t: 不让你就座，也是一种暴力
te: Not Seating You Is Also Violence
a: 选举不是权力来源，计票和就座才是。
ae: Elections aren't the source of power. Counting and seating are.

t: 怪习惯是她的，忍受是他的
te: Her Weird Habit, His Burden to Bear
a: 「得忍受」三个字，比任何婚讯都诚实
ae: "Our husbands have to put up with it" is more honest than any wedding announcement.

t: 十亿美元的补贴，买不回片场
te: A Billion Dollars Won't Buy Back the Soundstages
a: 补贴在给谁定价，谁在付账
ae: Subsidies price who gets paid, and who pays

t: 赦免的定价权在谁手里
te: Who Sets the Price of a Pardon
a: 他骂的不是贪，是没分成。
ae: He's not angry about corruption. He's angry he wasn't cut in.

t: 一部关于中年女人的小说，被拍成了哥特悬疑
te: A Novel About a Middle-Aged Woman, Sold as a Gothic Mystery
a: 原著是中年女人的一生，宣传语里她只剩一个背景
ae: The source novel is one woman's life; the logline gives her a backdrop.

t: 粉丝爱的是战争罪犯
te: Fans Love a War Criminal
a: 「人人都爱看的战争罪犯」——英雄叙事的糖衣下，暴力被包装成魅力。
ae: "A war criminal everybody loves to see" — the hero narrative wraps violence as charisma.

t: 污染者出钱，病人出力
te: The Polluters Pay, the Sick Pay Too
a: 把毒贩和病人绑进同一个联盟，是最高级的共谋。
ae: Binding the poisoned to the poisoners in one coalition is the highest form of complicity.

t: 谁有资格定义事实
te: Who Gets to Define the Facts
a: 禁掉一个台，是抢走解释权的最后一步。
ae: Banning a broadcaster is the last step in seizing the power to explain.

t: 两个女总裁，一个走一个升
te: Two Women Presidents, One Leaves, One Rises
a: 女性上位不等于解释权换手，先看谁在给谁腾位置。
ae: A woman in the top seat isn't the same as a shift in who gets to explain things.

t: 贴纸上的假字，谁在定价
te: Garbled Text on a Sticker, and Who Sets the Price
a: 连「我投了票」都交给机器代写，民主的表达先贬值了
ae: When even "I Voted" is machine-written, the expression of democracy gets devalued first.

t: 一条爆料，喂饱所有人
te: One Leak, Everyone Fed
a: 未证实的爆料不是新闻，是给粉丝的期货。
ae: An unverified leak isn't news. It's a futures contract sold to fans.

t: 嫁人是她唯一的剧本
te: Marriage Is Her Only Script
a: 特纳赢了，因为剧本只给了她这一条路。
ae: Turner wins because the script left her one road.

t: 把子宫写进宪法，然后呢
te: Write It Into the Constitution. Then What?
a: 公投赢了，不代表女人赢了。
ae: A ballot measure winning is not women winning.

t: 魔术演完了，账单还在
te: The Trick Is Over, the Bill Isn't
a: 他卖的是被看见的感觉，账单由台下的人付
ae: He sells the feeling of being seen; the audience pays the bill.

t: 换尺子的人又来量身高了
te: The Man Who Changes the Ruler Is Back to Measure Height
a: 抵免翻倍，产量照跌——这不是激励，是给一个正在搬走的行业付赎金。
ae: Doubling the credit while production keeps falling isn't an incentive. It's ransom paid to an industry already packing up.

t: 股票跌了，谁在付代价
te: The Stock Fell. Who Paid?
a: 把股价的起伏叫成机会，是有人替波动付了钱
ae: Calling a price swing an opportunity means someone else paid for the move.

t: 投票前一天，谁在制造事实
te: The Day Before the Vote, Who Manufactures Facts
a: 他们不需要赢官司，只需要让计票看起来可疑。
ae: They don't need to win the case. They need the count to look suspect.

t: 没人被踢走，只是位置一直空着
te: Nobody Got Kicked Off, the Seat Was Just Empty
a: 「没顶掉别人」的前提，是那个位置从没给别人留过。
ae: “I didn’t push anyone out” only works if the seat was never offered to anyone else.

t: 一部剧的体面，建在谁的身体上
te: Whose Body Holds Up the Drawing Room
a: 他们夸这集终于有了人味，人味来自一个女人不知道自己身体里发生了什么。
ae: They praise the show for finally giving people feelings. The feeling is a woman not knowing what happened inside her own body.

t: 没有起诉书，先关人
te: No Indictment, Just a Signature
a: 引渡不需要起诉书，只需要一个探员的签名。
ae: Extradition doesn't need an indictment. It needs one agent's signature.

t: 他终于被规则追上了
te: The Rules Finally Caught Him
a: 他失去的不是权力，是制造现实的能力
ae: What he lost wasn't power. It was the ability to manufacture reality.

t: 观众会累，钱不会累
te: Viewers Get Tired, the Money Doesn't
a: 收视率下滑被说成疲劳，广告收入照收——叙事在换皮，账本没动。
ae: Ratings dip is called fatigue; the ad money still lands. The narrative gets a new coat, the ledger doesn't move.

t: 她在镜头前交出的，是身体
te: What She Hands Over on Camera Is Her Body
a: 被观看的人自己讲身体，讲得越细，越像在替观看者写说明书。
ae: When the watched narrate their own bodies, the detail only writes a better manual for the watchers.

t: 免租的代价被写成了自由
te: The Price of Rent-Free Is Sold as Freedom
a: 她把寄人篱下重新命名为自由
ae: She renamed having no home as freedom.

t: 规则终于追上了他
te: The Rules Caught Up, Finally
a: 不是民主党赢了，是现实讨回了账
ae: Democrats didn't win. Reality collected a debt.

t: 她只是投一票，投给谁由未婚夫定
te: She's Just Casting One Vote. Her Fiancé Picked It.
a: 一个女人的「个人选择」，被包装成政治背叛，也被包装成勇敢。
ae: A woman's "personal choice" gets packaged as political betrayal, and also as bravery.

t: 强奸犯不会留邮箱
te: Rapists Don't Leave Their Email Addresses
a: 辩方没在证明无罪，只在给「强奸犯」重新画像
ae: The defense isn't proving innocence; it's redrawing the face of a rapist.

t: 朋克史把黑人删成了注脚
te: Punk History Erased the Black Band That Made It
a: 他们改写了朋克的肤色，历史却把肤色改了回去
ae: They changed punk's face; the record put the face back in the footnotes.

t: 被否决的法案也是资产
te: A Veto Is a Campaign Asset
a: 他把否决权当竞选素材，账单留给选民。
ae: He treats vetoes as campaign footage and sends voters the bill.

t: 先造一个敌人，再卖选票
te: Invent an Enemy, Then Sell the Ballot
a: 没有伊斯兰教法，只有需要伊斯兰教法的选举
ae: There is no Shariah in Texas. There is only an election that needs one.

t: 二十七条耳光，戏外还有更多
te: Twenty-Seven Takes, and Then Some
a: 只有一种人能在片场被折磨完再被写成天才的注脚
ae: Only one kind of person gets ground up on set and then written into a genius's footnote.

t: 二十年后登顶，卖的是怀旧
te: Twenty Years Later, Nostalgia Tops the Chart
a: 榜单换了尺子，青春被重新定价一次
ae: The chart changed its ruler; a youth got repriced

t: 福利诈骗是种族叙事的旧配方
te: Welfare Fraud Is the Old Racist Recipe
a: 「诈骗」只是包装，里面装的是黑人的脸
ae: 「Fraud」 is just the wrapper. Inside is a Black face.

t: 他造了传送门，又亲手拆了
te: He Built the Warp, Then Tore It Out
a: 设计一个让人绕路的系统，比让人直达更难。
ae: Designing a system that makes people take the long way is harder than letting them skip.

t: 他造谣，他收钱，他管平台
te: He Lies, He Pays, He Owns the Platform
a: 当一个人同时拥有平台、谣言和候选人支票，事实只是他随手可以下架的东西。
ae: When one man owns the platform, the rumor, and the candidates' checks, facts are just something he can quietly take down.

t: 中东的和平，签在能源合同里
te: Middle East Peace, Signed in Energy Contracts
a: 北京喊的是对话，签的是能源和本币互换。
ae: Beijing calls for dialogue and signs for oil and currency swaps.

t: 举报按钮也会挑人
te: Even the Report Button Picks Sides
a: 平台不给你举报的选项，就是在替你决定什么不算问题。
ae: When the platform removes your option to report, it has decided for you what doesn't count as a problem.

t: 钱不会说话，账户会
te: Money Doesn't Talk, Accounts Do
a: 外交的定价权，从来不在谈判桌上
ae: The price of diplomacy is never set at the negotiating table.

t: 提前投票不是民主的体温计
te: Early Voting Is Not a Democracy Thermometer
a: 投票率被当成天气预报，谁在付代价没人问。
ae: Turnout gets read as weather. Who pays for it never gets asked.

t: 一部没人看的电影，和一圈人的体面
te: A Movie Nobody Saw, and a Circle's Good Name
a: 票房输了，圈子里的定价权没输。
ae: The box office lost. The circle's power to price things didn't.

t: 又一个被陷害的女人上路了
te: Another Framed Woman on the Run
a: 被陷害是女性角色的入场券，不是意外
ae: Being framed is the entry ticket for a female character, not an accident.

t: 同一个第三号，两个方向
te: Same Amendment, Opposite Direction
a: 他们不反对公投，只反对公投赢他们。
ae: They don't oppose ballot measures. They oppose losing them.

t: 规则回来了，尺子没回来
te: The Rules Came Back. The Ruler Didn't.
a: 他输的不是道德，是解释权
ae: He didn't lose to morality. He lost the power to define reality.

t: 饥饿游戏原声带也在卖反抗
te: The Hunger Games Soundtrack Is Selling Rebellion Too
a: 把反乌托邦唱成金曲，反抗就成了货架上的口味
ae: Turn dystopia into a hit and resistance becomes a flavor on the shelf

t: 选举的广告，观众的疲劳
te: Election Ads, Viewer Fatigue
a: 政治广告的每一块钱，买的都是你的注意力席位。
ae: Every political ad dollar buys a seat in your attention.

t: 一句提示词挡不住抄袭
te: A Prompt Line Won't Stop Cloning
a: 规则写在提示词里，不写在能力里。
ae: A rule written in a prompt is not a rule written in the capability.

t: 先宣布选举无效
te: Declare the Election Rigged First
a: 他们不是在赢选举，是在预留一个「选举被偷了」的剧本。
ae: They are not trying to win the election. They are pre-booking the script for when it is stolen.

t: 四个人的圆满结局
te: A Happy Ending for Four
a: 「幸福结局」是叙事，不是事实。
ae: "Happy ending" is a narrative, not a fact.

t: 竖屏不是缺陷，是新的取景框
te: Vertical Isn't a Flaw. It's a New Frame.
a: 限制被用成语法，才叫本事
ae: Turning a limit into grammar — that's craft.

t: 作战室里没有选民
te: No Voters in the War Room
a: 平台把选举当成自家平台的事故，而不是公众的事
ae: The platforms treat the election as their own incident, not the public's.

t: 她数清了失序，没问是谁在定序
te: She Counted the Disorder, Never Asked Who Sets the Order
a: 她说政治不正常，却把正常当成了裁判席。
ae: She calls politics abnormal while treating normal as the referee's chair.

t: 换把尺子，裁掉量不出的
te: A New Ruler, Not a New Skill
a: 考核从来不是量能力，是量服从。
ae: The audit was never measuring skill. It was measuring obedience.

t: 最后一群蚂蚁也被定价了
te: The Last Colony Has a Price Tag Now
a: 偷蚁巢的人知道它值钱，这正是问题所在。
ae: Whoever took the nest knew what it was worth — that is the problem.

t: 穷人是她的道具
te: The Poor as Her Prop
a: 把别人的绝境穿在身上，再宣布这是关怀。
ae: She wore someone’s worst day as a costume, then called it care.

t: 一杯抹茶拿铁里的定价权
te: Pricing Power in a Matcha Latte
a: 她的身体是产品，她的松弛是卖点，采访只是包装纸。
ae: Her body is the product, her ease is the selling point, and the interview is just the wrapping.

t: 婚礼推迟，搬家照常
te: The Wedding Can Wait. The Moving Van Can't.
a: 她说婚礼要么不办要么大办，没人问这九年是谁在搬
ae: She says the wedding is all or nothing. Nobody asks who moved nine times.

t: 先判选举无效，再去投票
te: Write the Loss First, Vote Later
a: 他们不是在赢选举，是在给输准备说法。
ae: They aren't trying to win the election. They're preparing the alibi for losing it.

t: 专栏停了，戏还在演
te: The Column Ends, the Show Goes On
a: 换老板不是换叙事，只是换谁来收租。
ae: A new owner isn't a new narrative—just a new landlord collecting rent.

t: 他们连手术室都编好了
te: They Even Built the Operating Room
a: 先制造一个不存在的孩子，再让所有人去救他。
ae: Invent a child who doesn't exist, then send everyone to save him.

t: 投票不是策略，是止损
te: Voting Isn't a Strategy, It's Damage Control
a: 把票投出去，只是让差额不再扩大
ae: Casting the vote only keeps the gap from widening.

t: 独立女性这四个字，又替谁挡了一刀
te: 「Independent Woman」 Is a Great Place to Hide a Deal
a: 她不是崩溃，她是在给一笔交易找说法
ae: She didn't unravel. She was covering for a trade she couldn't name.

t: 毒物和解毒人睡一张床
te: The Poisoned Sleep With the Poisoners
a: 污染者出钱，MAHA 出人，共和党出货。
ae: Polluters pay, MAHA supplies the faces, the GOP supplies the permits.

t: 州警陪他看房，纳税人买单
te: State Troopers, Private Trips, Public Bill
a: 安保是公器，行程是私产，账单是公共的。
ae: Security is public. Itinerary is private. The bill is everyone's.

t: 恐惧是选票的稀释剂
te: Fear Is the Thinner That Waters Down Votes
a: 不必真的派ICE来，让人相信它会来就够了。
ae: ICE doesn't have to show up. Making people believe it will is enough.

t: 谎言不是失手，是产品
te: The Lie Is the Product
a: 他不制造事实，他制造接收事实的人。
ae: He doesn't manufacture facts. He manufactures the people who receive them.

t: 一件西装就能演邦德
te: One Suit and You're Bond
a: 邦德的西装是通行证，别人的西装是天花板
ae: A suit is a passport into the Bond shortlist, and a ceiling for everyone else.

t: 他骂的是记者的脸，怕的是自己的票
te: He Insulted the Reporter's Face, Not His Own Polls
a: 集会的效力在退潮，他先攻击的是提问者的长相
ae: When the rally loses its juice, he attacks the face of whoever asks.

t: 一千二百的增长，一百零四亿的窟窿
te: Twelvefold Growth, a Hundred-Billion Hole
a: 收入涨十二倍，亏损涨四倍，这门生意卖的是估值。
ae: Revenue up twelvefold, losses up fourfold: what this company sells is a valuation.

t: 选情越紧，他越值钱
te: The Tighter the Race, the More He's Worth
a: 焦虑被包装成专业，选票被压成一格一格的数据
ae: Anxiety packaged as expertise; voters compressed into cells

t: 她们偷偷看她，不敢关注她
te: They Watch Her in Secret, Never Follow
a: 上东区的太太们偷看一个中西部女人查案，因为解释权正在搬家
ae: Upper East Side wives lurk on a Midwest woman's records hunt because the power to explain is changing hands

t: 换教练救不了西汉姆
te: Sacking Nuno Won't Fix West Ham
a: 下课声里没人问：谁把球队造成这样
ae: Everyone asks who's to blame. Nobody asks who built this squad.

t: 网易关掉的不是工作室，是账本
te: NetEase Didn't Kill a Studio, It Killed a Line Item
a: 资本不杀创意，资本只算成本
ae: Capital doesn't kill creativity. It just prices it out.

t: 投票前先制造混乱，这就是统治术
te: Manufacture Chaos, Then Seize the Election
a: 先让选举看起来不可信，再以救世主姿态接管它
ae: Make the vote look rigged, then arrive as its rescuer.

t: 十八条清单，一个男人在给自己定价
te: Eighteen Items, One Man Repricing Himself
a: 把人际博弈写成戒断清单，是把自己重新摆上货架
ae: A list of things to quit is a man putting himself back on the shelf.

t: 排行榜第一不是音乐胜利
te: No. 1 Is Not a Musical Victory
a: 二十年后登顶的是榜单，不是作品。
ae: Twenty years later, the chart topped — not the work.

t: 一架绕路的专机，和一位姓 Burnham 的首相
te: A Detour, and a Prime Minister Named Burnham
a: 专机多绕一段路，问责的叙事就换了一个人。
ae: One extra leg of a flight, and accountability changes hands.

t: 推土机碾过的不是荒地
te: What the Bulldozer Turned Over
a: 法律被豁免之后，剩下的只有推土机。
ae: Once the law is waived, only the bulldozer is left.

t: 玩家被迫开枪的那一刻
te: The Moment the Player Is Made to Pull the Trigger
a: 让你亲手扣扳机，是把暴力从剧情变成共谋
ae: Forcing the player to fire turns violence from plot into complicity.

t: 应用商店是色情业的新皮条客
te: The App Stores Are the Porn Industry's New Pimp
a: 四百个伪装成宠物相册的App，把强奸做成模板上架。
ae: Four hundred pet-portrait apps, with rape sold as a template.

t: 换股买光，能力没换
te: Swapping Stock, Not Capability
a: 股价翻倍不是技术突破，是估值在换尺子
ae: A tripled market cap is not a breakthrough; it is a ruler being replaced.

t: 卖课的人，先给自己搭了神坛
te: The People Selling Courses Built Themselves an Altar First
a: 把创作者供成品牌，再把品牌拆成课程卖给下一批创作者。
ae: Turn creators into a brand, then sell the brand back to the next batch of creators as a course.

t: 骗子是白人，广告里是黑人
te: The Fraudsters Were White. The Ads Show Black Faces.
a: 福利诈骗的账，最后记在了黑人脸上
ae: A welfare scam gets billed to Black faces.

t: 他尊重女人说不，这就是他的辩护
te: He Respects It When a Woman Says No. That's the Defense.
a: 强奸案的辩护词，本身就是一份元暴力样本
ae: The closing speech is itself a sample of meta-violence.

t: 万圣节墓碑立错了地方
te: The Tombstones Are on the Wrong Lawn
a: 粉丝在给工作室立碑，资本在给表达定价。
ae: Fans build graves for studios; capital prices expression.

t: 不反抗不等于同意
te: Not Resisting Is Not Consent
a: 没喊没跑，是恐惧的证词，不是同意的证明。
ae: Not screaming, not running—that's a witness to fear, not proof of consent.

t: 电费单上的共谋者
te: The Co-Conspirators on the Bill
a: 监管者不再监管，账单就是选票。
ae: When regulators stop regulating, the bill becomes the ballot.

t: 国王的团结，没人问谁在买单
te: The King's Unity, and No One Asks Who Pays
a: 把袭击者划出"我们"，剩下的"我们"就不用被追问。
ae: Draw the attackers outside "us," and "us" never has to be questioned.

t: 围城里的医院只剩两成
te: In Taiz, the Hospitals Are Down to a Fifth
a: 战争叙事里没有平民，只有战线和士气
ae: War coverage counts terrain, morale and supply lines. It does not count the people those lines run through.

t: 叛逃不是意外，是共谋的账单
te: Defection Isn't an Accident. It's a Bill Coming Due.
a: 全党劝不住的倒戈，说明她从来不是失控，是被默许。
ae: The defection nobody could stop was never out of control. It was permitted.

t: 悲伤被拍成了她的成长背景
te: Grief, Cast as a Girl's Backdrop
a: 一部好电影把悲伤还给两个各自孤独的人，而不是一个懂事的女儿。
ae: A good film gives grief back to two lonely people, not to one dutiful daughter.

t: 跳舞节目让位选举，谁的身体还在台上
te: The Dance Show Steps Aside for the Vote
a: 把选票和投票秀并排，才看得清谁被当人
ae: Put the ballot and the talent show side by side, and see who counts as a person.

t: 一部电影的余温，卖第二遍
te: A Movie's Afterglow, Sold Twice
a: 电影放完，交响乐团进场，同一批人为同一份感动再付一次钱。
ae: The film ends, the orchestra enters, and the same people pay again for the same feeling.

t: 收视率图表不测量观众
te: The Ratings Chart Doesn't Measure Audiences
a: 排行榜丈量的是注意力怎么被卖，不是人怎么活。
ae: Rankings measure how attention gets sold, not how anyone lives.

t: 工会拿到了门禁卡，没拿到钥匙
te: A Badge to the Building, Not the Keys
a: 进得了办公室，不等于分得动利润
ae: Access to the office is not access to the surplus.

t: 一场选举里最贵的是解释权
te: The Priciest Thing in This Race Is the Right to Define
a: 一场选举真正的输赢，是叙事权归谁所有
ae: An election's real contest is over who gets to define the terms.

t: 两个女人卖票，六万五千人买单
te: Two Women Sell the Tickets, 65,000 Buy Them
a: 女性在舞台顶端，定价权还在别处。
ae: Women at the top of the bill; the pricing power is still elsewhere.

t: 八分钟妆容，两班倒的账
te: An Eight-Minute Face, a Two-Shift Ledger
a: 她卖的是表达，代价写在别人看不见的排班表上
ae: She sells expression; the cost is written on a schedule no one sees.

t: 反战不是良心，是流量
te: Anti-War Sells Better Than War
a: 他们不是背叛了MAGA，是换了一个能卖钱的MAGA。
ae: They didn't betray MAGA. They repackaged it for a new feed.

t: 油价跌了，战争还在
te: Oil Fell, the War Didn't
a: 市场为战争定价，却不为战争付代价
ae: Markets price the war, and pay none of its cost.

t: 年度专辑榜，谁在定义好音乐
te: Who Gets to Price a Year of Music
a: 品味没有高下，定价权有。
ae: Taste has no hierarchy. Pricing does.

t: 裁员名单上，没有「执行」
te: The Layoff List Has No "Execution" on It
a: 「执行不够好」是裁掉做执行的人，不是裁掉下命令的人
ae: "Execution isn't good enough" fires the people who execute, not the ones who order it.

t: 两分钟安全区救不了婚姻
te: Two Minutes Won't Save a Marriage
a: 把婚姻问题翻译成沟通技巧，是共谋者最省力的活
ae: Translating marriage into communication technique is the laziest job a co-conspirator can do

t: 冰箱被黑，谁在替谁挨饿
te: Who Pays When the Fridges Are Hacked
a: 攻击的是制冷设备，代价落在食物和人的身上。
ae: The attack hits the cooling units; the cost lands on food and people.

t: 换把尺子，事实就归你了
te: Change the Ruler, Own the Facts
a: AI搜索不是更准，是替你把解释权收走了
ae: AI search doesn't find truth better. It takes the interpreting away from you.

t: 一句安慰话被捧成史上最智慧
te: A Comforting Line Crowned the Wisest in Fantasy
a: 把顺从死亡的台词封为智慧，是叙事在替谁省事
ae: Calling submission to death wisdom is narrative doing someone a favor

t: 宪法危机是元暴力的遮羞布
te: The Constitutional Crisis Is Meta-Violence's Alibi
a: 谁在定义"民主受威胁"，谁就在垄断解释权
ae: Whoever defines "democracy under threat" owns the right to explain it.

t: 迪士尼酷女孩，还是迪士尼的酷生意
te: Disney Cool Girls, Still Disney's Cool Business
a: 叙事换皮，定价权没换手
ae: The label got a rebrand; the pricing power didn't move.

t: 一千一百五十亿的赌注，没有人下注
te: A $115 Billion Bet With No One at the Table
a: 交易额越惊人，正文里的人越少
ae: The bigger the deal, the fewer people in the story.

t: 米歇尔·康的两支球队，欧足联的麻烦
te: Two Clubs, One Owner, One Unwritten Rule
a: 同一老板的两家俱乐部要进同一项赛事，规则才发现自己没写这一条。
ae: When the same owner has two clubs in one competition, the rules discover they were never written.

t: 她十八岁那年，全组没人替她化妆
te: At Eighteen, Nobody Bothered to Do Her Makeup
a: 一个女演员的职业生涯，从学会自己划界限开始。
ae: A actress's career begins with learning to draw her own lines.

t: 五个最爱，一个定价入口
te: Five Favorites, One Pricing Gate
a: 她挑的是歌，平台挑的是谁能改歌
ae: She picked the songs; the platform picked who gets to rework them

t: 炸伊朗前，先数钱
te: Count the Profits Before the Bombs
a: 战争叙事换选票，油价换利润，代价记在别人账上。
ae: War narrative buys votes, oil prices buy profits, and someone else pays.

t: Forty-One Schools and a Promise Not Yet Built
a: The protests shrank. The demands didn't. The money was pledged. The classrooms weren't.

t: 富豪的恐惧值多少钱
te: What Billionaire Fear Is Worth
a: 333 million买不动的那部分，才是真问题
ae: The $333 million they spent to kill it is the only data point that matters.

t: 邦德选角是一场关于男人味的期货交易
te: The Bond Casting Is a Futures Market in Manhood
a: 007 的悬念不在谁能演，在谁被定价成那个男人。
ae: The suspense isn't who plays Bond. It's who gets priced as that man.

t: 骂影评人，是导演最后的营销
te: Blame the Critics, Dodge the Numbers
a: 票房差不是影评人害的，是没人想看。
ae: The box office didn't fail because of reviews. It failed because nobody came.

t: 最高法院在给施暴者发免罪符
te: The Court Is Handing Out Immunity
a: 把追责的门一扇扇焊死，暴力才成了制度
ae: Weld shut every door to accountability, and violence becomes the system.

t: 谁在二十三年前就该被追问
te: Who Should Have Been Asked 23 Years Ago
a: 一部拆穿富豪家族的剧，被写成了一份履历表
ae: A show that skewered a wealthy family became a résumé checklist.

t: 氟化物退场，谁在收智商税
te: Fluoride Steps Aside, Who Collects the Toll
a: 反氟叙事打开的市场，账单寄给不刷牙的孩子。
ae: An anti-fluoride narrative opens a market; the bill goes to children who can't pay.

t: 没钱的人不配有政治
te: The Poor Aren't Allowed Politics
a: 把生存焦虑说成务实，是给沉默发奖状
ae: Calling survival anxiety pragmatism is a gold star for silence.

t: 他怀念的是从未存在的帝国
te: He Mourns an Empire That Never Was
a: 马斯克悼念的不是星战，是他自己没当上的皇帝
ae: Musk isn't mourning Star Wars. He's mourning the throne he never got.

t: AI 出海，谁在付账
te: Who Pays for AI Going Abroad
a: 大模型进政府，先改的不是效率，是解释权
ae: When models enter government, the first thing rewritten is interpretation.

t: 四百万份的武侠，谁在定价
te: Four Million Copies of Wuxia, and Who Sets the Price
a: 功夫被做成动画，卖给了全世界。
ae: Kung fu became animation, and animation got sold.

t: 导弹被拦下了，医院没有
te: The Missile Was Intercepted. The Hospitals Weren't.
a: 被拦截的导弹上头条，被围困的医院不上。
ae: An intercepted missile makes the headline. A besieged hospital doesn't.

t: 他们不回你，是因为你值六美元
te: They Don't Text Back Because You're Worth $6
a: 你的手机号不是你的，是数据经纪商的资产
ae: Your phone number isn't yours. It's a data broker's asset.

t: 榜单是评价方式，不是能力
te: A List Is a Way of Rating, Not a Way of Measuring
a: 把作品变成可点开的清单，是平台在重新定义什么叫好
ae: Turning art into a clickable list is the platform redefining what counts as good

t: 扮老鼠的巨星，和不必扮的人
te: A Superstar Dressed as a Rat, and Those Who Can't Choose
a: 有人在台上扮老鼠，有人在台下被定价。
ae: One man wears a rat suit by choice. Others are priced by what they wear.

t: 把穷人穿在身上
te: Wearing Poverty as a Costume
a: 她不是在扮演流浪汉，是在给慈善履历借一张脸
ae: She didn't dress as a homeless person. She borrowed one for her charity résumé.

t: 招生办的笑脸不是慈善
te: A Friendly Admissions Office Is Not Charity
a: 大学突然友善，是因为学生变成了稀缺资源
ae: Colleges got friendly because students became scarce, not because they got kind.

t: 两个男人换衣服，粉丝找彩蛋
te: Two Men Swap Clothes, Fans Hunt Easter Eggs
a: 没有代价，没有叙事，只有一场营销
ae: No cost, no narrative — just a release-date reminder.

t: 核警报是假的，恐惧是真的
te: The Nuclear Alert Was Fake. The Fear Was Not.
a: 假警报不需要可信，只需要让人想起真的。
ae: A fake alarm doesn't need to be believed. It only needs to remind you of the real one.

t: 换一把尺子，就有了政绩
te: Change the Ruler, Keep the Record
a: 能力没变，评价方式变了，差额就消失了
ae: The capability didn't change. The metric did. The gap disappeared.

t: 一条毯子的定价权
te: The Price Tag on a Blanket
a: 卖的不是毯子，是“好莱坞同款”这五个字的席位。
ae: What's for sale isn't the blanket. It's a seat in the "Hollywood-approved" club.

t: 一场婚礼的抽奖经济学
te: The Raffle Economics of a Wedding
a: 用游戏换抽奖券，把人情做成了劳动
ae: Games for tickets: hospitality repriced as labor.

t: 选举压力不是天气，是人造的
te: Election Pressure Is Not Weather. It Is Built.
a: 把地方选举官拖进全国聚光灯的，不是选票，是叙事。
ae: What drags local election officials into the national spotlight is narrative, not ballots.

t: 宠物不是明星的配件
te: Pets Are Not Celebrity Accessories
a: 把宠物列成权力榜，是在给爱标价
ae: Ranking pets by their owners' fame puts a price on love

t: 宠物滤镜下面藏着刀
te: The Pet Filter Has a Knife Under It
a: 真正的产品不是滤镜，是女人的身体。
ae: The real product isn't the filter. It's women's bodies.

t: 反犹标签是新的猎巫
te: The Antisemitism Label Is the New Witch Hunt
a: 用反犹指控封杀反战者，是元暴力的标准操作
ae: Branding an anti-war candidate antisemitic is meta-violence's standard move.

t: 他被杀两次：一次用刀，一次用制服
te: Killed Twice: Once by a Knife, Once by Handcuffs
a: 警方保护的是自己的声誉，不是濒死的人。
ae: The police protected their reputation, not a dying teenager.

t: 万圣节合照，谁在付账
te: A Halloween Photo, and Who Pays
a: 一张合照不是共同养育，是共同养育的公关版本
ae: A photo op is not co-parenting. It's the PR version of it.

t: 生完孩子，她的子宫归谁签字
te: After the Birth, Her Uterus Belonged to His Signature
a: 一场分娩戏最诚实的部分，是医生先告诉丈夫
ae: The most honest part of a birth scene: the doctor tells the husband first.

t: 谁在给一个十几岁的保姆定价
te: Who Priced the Teenage Babysitter
a: 罗莎琳被记住的是一句狠话，没人问她为什么在打工。
ae: Rosalyn is remembered for a threat; nobody asks why she took the job.

t: 公投从未举行，维和已经打包
te: The Referendum Never Happened; the Peacekeepers Are Packing
a: 一场从未兑现的自决公投，最后以清点装备收场
ae: A self-determination vote that never took place ends with an inventory of equipment.

t: 一部纪录片赢了，赢的是票房还是叙事
te: A Documentary Won, but What Did It Win?
a: 霍尔姆斯被拍成奇观，她的受害者没进镜头。
ae: Holmes is the spectacle; her victims never enter the frame.

t: 河马死在旱季里
te: The Hippos Died in the Dry Season
a: 干旱不是天灾，是分配问题
ae: Drought is not a natural disaster. It is a distribution problem.

t: 照护者从来不是主角
te: The Carer Never Gets a Scene
a: 一部关于帕金森的电影，主角是病人，付代价的是没上台的人。
ae: A film about Parkinson's puts the patient centre stage and leaves the person paying the cost off-screen.

t: 扮成断手的人，卖的是谁的身体
te: A Severed Hand, Priced and Framed
a: 万圣节最贵的装扮，是把自己做成展品
ae: The most expensive costume is turning yourself into an exhibit.

t: 旅伴问卷测不出谁在买单
te: The Travel Quiz Can't Measure Who Pays
a: 旅行兼容性问卷只问合不合，不问谁在付代价
ae: The quiz asks if you're compatible, never who pays for it

t: 疏散三万人的名单里没有谁
te: Who Isn't on the List of Thirty Thousand
a: 灾难不分配暴力，它只是把既有的分配照抄一遍
ae: A disaster doesn't distribute violence; it copies the existing distribution.

t: 中期选举不是天气预报
te: Midterms Are Not Weather
a: 把结构暴力写成自然规律，是元暴力最体面的一次出场
ae: Turning structural violence into a natural cycle is meta-violence's most respectable appearance.

t: 一张专辑的排名，和排名里的那套爱情剧本
te: An Album Ranking, and the Love Script Inside It
a: 排行榜给歌排名，歌给女人排位置
ae: Charts rank songs; songs rank where women stand.

t: 私募信贷的文明叙事
te: The Civilized Story of Private Credit
a: 十亿欧元的贷款能力，定价权不在借钱的人手里
ae: Eleven billion in lending capacity, and the pricing power sits with the lender, not the borrower.

t: 杀人的妈妈，和杀怪物的女孩
te: The Murderous Mom and the Girl Who Kills Monsters
a: 把金发女孩从第一个死的人，变成怪物害怕的东西。
ae: It turned the blonde who dies first into the thing monsters fear.

t: 涨价的账单，永远往下传
te: The Bill Always Travels Downhill
a: 成本从不消失，只换一个人扛。
ae: Costs never vanish. They just find someone else to carry them.

t: 五个位置全是女人，电台里还是两个
te: Five Women on the Chart, Two on the Radio
a: 流媒体把女人送进前五，电台把她们留在门外
ae: Streaming put women in the top five; radio kept them outside it

t: 一部剧的结尾，和一个女人的身体
te: A UTI, a Dragon Queen, and the End of Youth
a: 创作者把痛苦当素材，这不算剥削，算手艺。
ae: Turning pain into material isn't exploitation. It's craft.

t: 人死在牢里，罪名是间谍
te: He Died in Custody, Charged as a Spy
a: 谁控制监狱和病历，谁就控制死因。
ae: Whoever controls the prison and the medical file controls the cause of death.

t: 电影节三十周年，谁在付代价
te: Thirty Years of Film, Who Pays
a: 排片表上的母亲，和排片表外的母亲
ae: Mothers on the screen, mothers missing from the crew list

t: 榜单排的是歌，卖的是人
te: The Chart Ranks Songs. It Sells a Person.
a: 十五首歌的排名，是一份定价单。
ae: Fifteen songs, ranked: that's a price list.

t: 极右翼的摇篮不是愤怒，是训练
te: The Far Right's Nursery Isn't Anger, It's Training
a: 他们不是在发泄愤怒，他们是在上岗。
ae: They aren't venting rage. They're clocking in.

t: 四亿美元买不到一次看场合
te: $400 Million Can't Buy a Room Read
a: 把穷人的绝境穿在身上，再把蜡烛卖给你。
ae: She wore destitution as a costume, then sold you a candle.

t: 两场婚礼，一个换乘故事
te: Two Weddings, One Transfer Story
a: 浪漫爱叙事把离婚写成换乘，把女人写成站点。
ae: Romance narrative turns divorce into a transfer, and women into stations.

t: 用催泪弹谈工资
te: Tear Gas Over a Wage Negotiation
a: 三十八亿美元的产业，靠十二万五千塔卡撑着。
ae: A $38bn industry, held up by 12,500 taka a month.

t: 一张红毯照，谁在复出
te: A Red Carpet Photo, and Who Gets to Return
a: 他没有被证明清白，只是被允许重新出现
ae: He was never cleared. He was just allowed back.

t: 撤军不是归还
te: Withdrawal Is Not Restitution
a: 枪走了，家没了，这叫撤军不叫结束
ae: The guns left. The homes didn't come back. That's a redeployment, not an ending.

t: 三十秒的平静，谁来付账
te: Thirty Seconds of Calm, and Who Pays for It
a: 把结构性的疲惫包装成三十秒的自助技巧，是文化暴力在卖止痛药。
ae: Packaging structural exhaustion as a 30-second self-help trick is cultural violence selling painkillers.

t: 中期选举不是解药
te: A Midterm Is Not a Cure
a: 换掉一个人，暴力结构原地不动
ae: Swap one man out, the violence structure stays put.

t: 没有代价的赞美最廉价
te: Praise Without a Price Tag Is the Cheapest Kind
a: 他夸的不是她，是她的成功配得上他的耳朵
ae: He isn't praising her. He's certifying that her success deserves his ear.

t: 票房冠军是纪录片，这算什么新闻
te: A Documentary Won the Weekend. So What
a: 一部纪录片拿周末冠军，赢的只是档期空窗
ae: A documentary took No. 1 because nobody else showed up.

t: 家族席位与草根表演
te: A Family Seat, a Grassroots Show
a: 他们争的是解释权，不是席位
ae: They're fighting over interpretation, not the seat.

t: 一场演唱会名单，和它没写的那行字
te: A Concert Lineup and the Line It Left Out
a: 十二个夜晚，两个女声，其余全是男声——这不是巧合，是定价。
ae: Twelve nights, two women headlining. That's not an accident. That's a price tag.

t: 燃烧的警察与失踪的被告
te: A Burning Officer and the Missing Defendants
a: 暴力三角里，直接层被看见，结构层被消音。
ae: The direct layer gets a charge; the structural layer gets silence.

t: 不是她写不出来，是行业不让她写
te: She Wasn't Out of Songs. The Industry Wouldn't Let Her Write Them
a: 把女性创作史排成榜单，就是一次解释权的回收
ae: Ranking a woman's catalog is how the industry takes back the right to explain her.

t: 坠机不是天灾
te: A Crash Is Not Weather
a: 九条命换来的，是一份还没写出来的报告
ae: Nine lives bought a report that hasn't been written yet.

t: 偷票的人先喊抓贼
te: The Ones Stealing Votes Shout Thief First
a: 先定义谁是小偷，再让选票作废。
ae: Define the thief first, then void the ballots.

t: 枪没走火，走火的是人设
te: The Gun Didn't Misfire. The Persona Did.
a: 一个拍了半辈子枪的男人，被自己腰里的枪打中了。
ae: A man who spent a career filming guns got shot by the one on his hip.

t: 换把尺子，宣布世界第一
te: Change the Ruler, Declare Yourself First
a: “世界最高性能”不是测出来的，是预算里写出来的。
ae: "World's highest performance" isn't measured. It's written into the budget.

t: 上流社会的贞操只押在女人身上
te: The Gilded Age Only Pawns Women's Virtue
a: 同一个夜晚，男的是成长，女的是毁灭。
ae: Same night: his coming-of-age, her ruin.

t: 榜单是尺子，不是事实
te: A Chart Is a Ruler, Not a Fact
a: 把专辑排成一二三四，就是替听众把判断力提前花掉。
ae: Ranking albums spends the listener's judgment before they get to use it.

t: 一句台词，替所有人免了账
te: One Line, and Everyone Gets Off
a: 「没有人真正消失」是赦免，不是救赎。
ae: "No one's ever really gone" is a pardon, not redemption.

t: 油价跌了，仗还没打完
te: Oil Fell, the War Didn't
a: 市场为一句“愿意和平”跌了3%，战争没停，只是换了说法。
ae: The market priced a sentence about peace. The strikes are still being prepared.

t: 失踪九个月，谁在付代价
te: Nine Months, No Arrest
a: 一个老人被从家里带走，九个月无人被捕，这才是新闻。
ae: An 84-year-old was taken from her home. Nine months later, no one has been arrested.

t: 金属探测器对准了谁
te: Who the Metal Detector Is Really For
a: 把穆斯林说成炸弹，是为了让选票替他排爆。
ae: Calling a Muslim a bomb is how you get votes to do the defusing.

t: 提前投票创纪录，不是民主的胜利
te: Record Early Voting Is Not a Democratic Victory
a: 投票率是症状，不是权力本身。
ae: Turnout is a symptom, not power itself.

t: 增重二十磅，一次可计算的投资
te: Twenty Pounds, a Calculable Investment
a: 身体是男演员唯一必须自己垫付的成本
ae: An actor's body is the one cost he must front himself

t: 恐怖是糖衣，爱情是入口
te: Horror Is the Sugar, Romance Is the Door
a: 把浪漫爱装进恐怖里，卖的还是同一种东西
ae: Wrap romance in horror and you're still selling the same thing

t: 六万人跑过五座桥，奖台只给一部分人
te: Sixty Thousand Cross Five Bridges, the Podium Opens for Some
a: 参赛资格被卖成商品，领奖台才开始学着开门
ae: Entry is priced as a product; the podium is only learning to open its door.

t: 排行榜也是定价权
te: The Chart Is Also the Price Tag
a: 她破的是纪录，榜单定的是她值多少
ae: She broke the record; the list set her price.

t: 两千美元的折痕
te: The Crease in a $2,000 Screen
a: 一块屏幕的折痕，是能力配不上定价的裂缝
ae: A crease in the glass is a crack between capability and price.

t: 独立选民是一场统计幻觉
te: The Independent Voter Is a Statistical Illusion
a: 1170万独立派，被两党按票仓瓜分
ae: 117 million independents, already allocated to two parties.

t: 榜单是尺子，不是命
te: The Chart Is a Ruler, Not a Fate
a: 被谁挡住，从来不是重点；谁在定义"红"，才是。
ae: Who blocked you was never the point. Who defines "a hit" is.

t: 好莱坞自己给自己拍神话
te: Hollywood Writes Its Own Mythology
a: 一部关于掩盖丑闻的电影，本身就是一次掩盖。
ae: A film about covering up scandals is itself a cover-up.

t: 69条命，换不来一个刹车
te: 69 Lives, and No One Hit the Brake
a: 安全系统的失败不是天灾，是有人签字放行的结构暴力
ae: A safety system's failure is not an accident. Someone signed off on it.

t: 警报器被黑，谁在替它说话
te: Who Speaks for the Siren
a: 先黑掉警报，再宣布警报不可信。
ae: Hack the alarm first, then declare all alarms untrustworthy.

t: 卖掉银行的人说这叫专业
te: The People Selling the Bank Call It Professional
a: 一次私有化里，定价权比罢工更早被私有化了。
ae: In a privatization, the pricing power gets privatized before the bank does.

t: 两个男人走过街，没人问他们是谁
te: Two Men Cross a Street and Nobody Asks Who They Are
a: 不开口的男人是布景，开口的女人是剧情。
ae: Silent men are scenery; speaking women are plot.

t: 影评人不是失意的艺术家
te: Critics Aren't Failed Artists
a: 把批评者说成失败者，就是在取消批评本身。
ae: Calling critics failed artists is how you cancel criticism itself.

t: 十万块石头，一个国家的焦虑
te: A Hundred and Eight Stones, One Country's Anxiety
a: 用宗教仪式包装经济焦虑，代价由年轻人付。
ae: A religious spectacle wrapping economic panic, paid for by the young.

t: 不卖Xbox，也不卖以色列
te: No Xbox, No Israel
a: 把渠道当成表态，是表达武器化的反向操作
ae: Treating distribution as a statement is weaponized expression run in reverse.

t: 榜单是尺子，不是事实
te: The Chart Is a Ruler, Not a Fact
a: 排行榜测量的从来不是音乐，是谁被允许被听见。
ae: A ranking never measures music. It measures who was allowed to be heard.

t: 她替所有人扛下了脏活
te: She Took the Dirty Work for Everyone
a: 一部剧把女性共谋拍得毫不留情，这就是它值钱的地方
ae: A show that films female complicity without flinching is worth its weight

t: 初选输了，就把票投给对面
te: She Lost the Primary, So She Endorsed the Other Side
a: 被自己党内击败的人去给对方站台，这不是背叛，是共谋的价码
ae: When the loser of a primary campaigns for the opponent, that's not betrayal. That's the price of complicity.

t: 谁在偷，谁在喊偷
te: Who Stole What, and Who Shouts Theft
a: 把败选说成被偷，是解释权的最后一搏
ae: Calling a loss a theft is the last stand of interpretive power.

t: 温和派的账，最后都记在别人头上
te: The Moderate's Bill Is Paid by Someone Else
a: 他的温和不是立场，是让别人替他付账的手续费。
ae: His moderation isn't a position. It's a processing fee charged to other people.

t: 芯片换尺子，谁在定价
te: Chips Change the Ruler, Not the Game
a: 算力叙事的定价权，不在韩国手里
ae: The pricing power in the AI compute story is not in Seoul.

t: 两个影帝的六秒背景板
te: Two Stars, Six Seconds, No Credit
a: 名利场里，权力连跑龙套都要插队
ae: Even the extras' line has a VIP entrance.

t: 经纪人死了，合同从来没有
te: The Manager Died. The Contract Never Existed.
a: 六十年没有一纸合同，这才是这段关系里最贵的东西
ae: Sixty years without a contract: that was the most expensive thing in the room.

t: 六秒钟的群众演员
te: Six Seconds of Extras
a: 最贵的表达，是让自己看起来没在表达。
ae: The most expensive expression is the one that looks like no expression at all.

t: 公投被删掉一个字母
te: One Letter Removed
a: 一个字母的删除，就是三十五年维和的结束。
ae: Deleting one letter ended thirty-five years of peacekeeping.

t: 一场体面的告别，谁在付账
te: A Decent Goodbye, and Who Pays for It
a: 照护的温柔被写成佳话，账单却没人提
ae: Care is written as a lovely anecdote; the bill goes unmentioned.

t: 邮局少收一次信，选票就作废了
te: One Fewer Mail Pickup, One Vote Erased
a: 削减成本省下的每一分钱，都从某个人的选票上扣掉。
ae: Every dollar saved on rural mail is deducted from someone's ballot.

t: 恋爱时间线是一门生意
te: A Romance Timeline Is a Price List
a: 名人恋情时间线，是给表达定价的行情表
ae: Celebrity romance timelines price expression, not people.

t: 哥斯拉踩过银座，谁在鼓掌
te: Godzilla Stomps Ginza, and the Crowd Applauds
a: 怪兽片的能量，来自战后废墟的账还没算清
ae: The monster film's energy comes from a war debt nobody has settled

t: 和平是打完再说
te: Peace, After We Finish Bombing
a: “prefer to do it peacefully”是战争叙事里最省成本的一句话
ae: "Prefer to do it peacefully" is the cheapest line in the war playbook.

t: 棒球外交的投手是谁
te: Who's on the Mound in Diamond Diplomacy
a: 用棒球讲友谊，用友谊盖住谁在投球
ae: A film about friendship that hides who is pitching.

t: 涓滴经济学卖不动了
te: Trickle-Down Has Lost Its Price Tag
a: 选民不是转向左翼，是发现自己的命从来没和董事会绑在一起。
ae: Voters didn't turn left. They noticed their fate was never tied to the boardroom.

t: 六天停火，换不来第六天之后
te: Six Days of Truce, Nothing After
a: 停火不是和平，是一次被允许的呼吸
ae: A ceasefire is not peace; it is a breath you are permitted to take.

t: 背叛的价码由谁付
te: Who Pays for the Betrayal
a: 一场个人恩怨被包装成路线之争，真正被定价的是选民。
ae: A personal feud is the label that hides who priced the voters.

t: 赦免权不是漏洞，是设计
te: Pardon Power Is Not a Bug, It Is the Design
a: 把赦免权叫成制宪者的失误，是在替制度免责。
ae: Calling the pardon power a founding error lets the design off the hook.

t: 用AI当尺子，量的是谁
te: A New Ruler, Not a New Skill
a: 不换能力，换尺子：AI考核只是裁员的体面说法
ae: Re-interviewing staff about AI is layoffs with a nicer name.

t: 扮穷人博眼球，蜡烛才是重点
te: Dressing Poor, Selling Candles
a: 把无家可归者当道具的人，从不觉得自己在共谋
ae: Whoever uses the homeless as a prop never thinks they're complicit.

t: 唱完歌，毒水还在
te: They Sang, the Water Stayed Poisoned
a: 和谐叙事是共谋者的最优解表达
ae: Harmony talk is the co-conspirator's optimal expression.

t: 两个同名候选人，一场选举的元暴力
te: Two Dan Sullivans and the Meta-Violence of an Election
a: 法官驳回的不是一场诉讼，是解释权的挪用
ae: The judge didn't dismiss a lawsuit. He blocked a claim on interpretation.

t: 八十二岁的女歌手不该被要求退场
te: An 82-Year-Old Singer Shouldn't Be Told to Bow Out
a: 同一场演出，八十六岁的他是传奇，八十二岁的她该退场。
ae: Same stage: at 86 he's a legend, at 82 she should retire.

t: 首位女总统，和一场27%的投票
te: A First Female President, and a 27% Turnout
a: 把女性推上最高位置，不等于把女性从结构里解放出来。
ae: Putting a woman at the top is not the same as taking women out of the structure.

t: 飞机砸下来，先问谁在飞
te: The Jet Came Down. Ask Who Was Flying.
a: 九条命换来的不是答案，是又一份等待中的报告。
ae: Nine deaths produced no answer, only another report to wait for.

t: 公务机坠毁，谁在付代价
te: A Business Jet Fell, and the Ground Paid
a: 一场空难被写成奇观，遇难者成了背景
ae: A crash is reported as spectacle; the dead become a number

t: 华尔街好就是大家好，这话卖不动了
te: Wall Street Good Was Main Street Good. That Pitch Is Dead.
a: 选民不信涓滴，是因为他们终于算清了自己那笔账
ae: Voters stopped believing in trickle-down because they finally did the math on their own paycheck.

t: 魅力不是红旗，解释权才是
te: Charisma Isn't the Red Flag. Who Gets to Explain Is.
a: 把魅力当红旗，是让人别再相信任何表达
ae: Calling charisma a red flag tells people to trust no one's expression.

t: 他夸她忠诚，因为忠诚是单向的
te: He Praised Her Loyalty Because Loyalty Only Runs One Way
a: 共谋的回报是让你成为他叙事里的一件道具
ae: The reward for complicity is becoming a prop in his narrative.

t: 书呆子进了舞会，然后呢
te: The Bookworm Went to the Ball. Then What?
a: 她问对了问题，但提问不是答案
ae: She asked the right question. Asking is not answering.

t: 公民身份是发给听话的人的
te: Citizenship Is a Receipt for Obedience
a: 国籍不是权利，是服从的收据。
ae: Nationality isn't a right. It's a receipt for compliance.

t: 榜单不是事实，是尺子
te: The Chart Is Not a Fact, It's a Ruler
a: 换尺子的那天，双榜第一就已经注定了
ae: The day they changed the ruler, the double No. 1 was already decided.

t: 换把尺子，岗位就涨了1721%
te: Change the Ruler, and the Jobs Jump 1,721%
a: 招聘数据的涨幅是评价方式变了，不是能力变了
ae: The 1,721% measures a change in how we count, not in what exists.

t: 六十年无合同，握手值多少
te: Sixty Years, No Contract
a: 他替她补工资那笔钱，才是这段关系的真相
ae: The money he quietly paid her is the real story of that handshake

t: 骗局背后是另一场奴役
te: Behind the Scam, Another Slavery
a: 假粉丝信背后，写的人也是被关着的人。
ae: The fake fan letter is written by someone who is also locked up.

t: 马拉松第一次给轮椅和义肢发奖
te: The Marathon Finally Gave Out Podiums. Not Prize Money.
a: 奖杯发了，奖金没发，这就是包容的定价。
ae: A podium without a purse is inclusion with a price tag.

t: 举铁不是力量，是投票
te: Pumping Iron Is Not Strength. It's a Vote.
a: 民主党举铁，举的是男性中心叙事里"强"的定价权。
ae: Democrats lifting weights are lifting the masculine narrative's power to define "strong."

t: 拆掉闸门的人来验收水坝
te: The Man Dismantling the Dam Arrives to Inspect It
a: 选票的投递权，正在被重新定价
ae: The right to have your ballot delivered is being repriced.

t: 没有孩子，就没有人替你签字
te: No Children Means No One to Sign for You
a: 他把照护危机说成个人规划问题，这就是共谋。
ae: Framing a care crisis as a personal planning problem is complicity.

t: 圣诞歌单没有新人
te: The Christmas Canon Has Stopped Recording
a: 十六首节日金曲，最年轻的一首也已经十二岁了。
ae: Sixteen holiday hits, and the youngest is already twelve years old.

t: 重启一部牧师家庭剧，改不了它的骨架
te: A Reboot of a Pastor's Family Can't Change Its Skeleton
a: 把限制说成限制，本身就是一种表达
ae: Calling a limit a limit is itself an expression

t: 电影感是一种定价权
te: Film Look Is a Pricing Power
a: 他们卖的不是相机，是署名权
ae: They're not selling a camera. They're selling a signature.

t: 同性情侣跳支舞，就算进步了
te: A Same-Sex Pairing Is Not a Power Shift
a: representation 换的是台上配对，不是谁在定价
ae: Representation changes who's on stage, not who sets the price.

t: 投票日前的牢骚，绕开了谁在关门
te: The Curmudgeon Rants, the Polling Places Close
a: 把投票站关掉的人，不会出现在段子里
ae: He jokes about stickers; someone else shuts the polling places.

t: 一个二十六岁男人的脖子，和九分钟的沉默
te: A 26-Year-Old's Neck and Nine Minutes of Silence
a: 橄榄球把身体变成耗材，再为耗材祈祷。
ae: Football turns bodies into consumables, then prays for the consumables.

t: 二十五周冠军是尺子换来的
te: 25 Weeks at No. 1 Is a Ruler Change
a: 榜单变长了，不是歌变强了。
ae: The chart got longer, not the songs stronger.

ae: When ballots get rigged, nobody asks what voters wanted.

ae: A mixtape of manhood: women appear only in the dressing room, secretly.

ae: The diagnostic war is a war over whose interpretation counts.

ae: Zoning is fossilized segregation. SB 79 chipped off one corner.

t: 道歉是免费的，账单不是

a: 榜单不是记录，是定价权的一次行使
ae: A list is not a record. It is an exercise of the power to price.
