ae: The cure exists. The pricing power belongs to someone else.

t: 囤豆子和囤现金，都是同一场表演
te: Hoarding Beans, Hoarding Cash: Same Performance
a: 政府在分发恐惧，然后卖给你应对恐惧的清单。
ae: The government distributes fear, then sells you the checklist for it.

t: 游戏改编不是新故事，是新库存
te: Game Adaptations Aren't New Stories. They're New Inventory.
a: 好莱坞不是找到新叙事，是找到没被开采过的认知入口
ae: Hollywood didn't find new narratives. It found unmined cognitive entry points.

t: 无人驾驶的账，谁来付
te: Who Pays for the Robotaxi
a: 技术往前冲，代价永远先落在最没议价权的人身上。
ae: Tech moves forward; the bill always lands first on those with the least bargaining power.

t: 一百二十四比六，尺子换了
te: 124-6: The Ruler Got Swapped
a: 把女子比赛打得比男子更狠，不是进步，是同一把尺子。
ae: Beating the men's record isn't progress. It's the same ruler, now with women on it.

t: 撞钢琴的人，和写讣告的人
te: The Man Who Hit the Piano, and the Man Who Wrote the Obituary
a: 一句'不疼不长进'，把死亡写成了职业精神
ae: 'No pain, no gain' turns a death into a work ethic.

t: 一个笑话演了十年还在演
te: A Joke That's Been Running for Ten Years
a: 当一个段子只能靠重播自己活着，它就成了体制。
ae: When a bit survives only by replaying itself, it becomes an institution.

t: 万圣节扮装，扮的是谁的自由
te: Halloween Costumes, and Whose Freedom They Dress Up
a: 两套戏服轮换，表达被定价成一场cosplay
ae: Two costumes in one night: expression priced as cosplay.

t: 河岸被占，草料靠抢
te: The Riverbank Was Taken First
a: 旱灾不是天灾，是谁能先占到河岸的分配问题
ae: Drought is not weather. It is a fight over who reaches the riverbank first.

t: 一支被低估的乐队，和一篇不追问的讣闻
te: An Underrated Group, and an Obit That Asks Nothing
a: 当纪念只谈歌单，解释权就留在了原处
ae: When a tribute is only a playlist, the power to define stays put.

t: 民调领先不等于赢
te: Leading in the Polls Is Not Winning
a: 民调是表达，选票是博弈，两者从不重合。
ae: Polls are expression; votes are the game. They never coincide.

t: 一百亿买不回一句话
te: A Hundred Billion Can't Buy a Sentence
a: 他想买断的不是诽谤，是解释权
ae: He wasn't buying damages. He was buying the right to define fact.

t: 兽人吃人，也开会
te: Orcs Eat People, and They Also Hold Meetings
a: 最像人的怪物，是那个会管团队的。
ae: The most human monster is the one managing a team.

t: 断手不是身体，是赞助位
te: A Severed Hand Is Not a Body, It's a Sponsorship Slot
a: 她的身体被拆成零件，再被卖回给她自己。
ae: Her body gets taken apart and sold back to her.

t: 生日是身份，不是验证码
te: Your Birthday Is an Identity, Not a Passcode
a: 你的生日被拿去当钥匙，责任却记在你头上
ae: They use your birthday as a key, then bill you for the lock

t: 一场巡演，两个家暴者，满场掌声
te: Two Men, One Tour, Zero Mention of the Violence
a: 把施暴者供上神坛，是共谋最响的一次合唱。
ae: Putting an abuser on a pedestal is complicity singing in unison.

t: 黑帮片最爱的就是这种台词
te: Gangster Cinema's Favorite Line Is a Conspirator's Confession
a: 把世界变成自己的产物，是共谋者的自白，不是自由。
ae: Making the world your product isn't freedom. It's a confession.

t: AI 接管轻松活，人接住所有烂摊子
te: AI Takes the Easy Work, Humans Keep the Wreckage
a: 自动化把缓冲垫抽走，留下的人承受全部强度
ae: Automation removes the buffer and leaves people with all the intensity

t: 穿一次男人的衣服，不叫表达自由
te: Wearing a Man's Shirt Is Not Freedom
a: 换装是表达，不是解放；她穿的是戏服，不是权力。
ae: A costume change is expression, not liberation. She wore the role, not the power.

t: 工资委员会不加工资
te: A Wage Board Is Not a Wage
a: 工人要的是钱，政府给的是椅子。
ae: Workers asked for money. The government handed them a chair.

t: 医生在救人和埋葬之间
te: Doctors Between Saving and Burying
a: 被炸掉的医院还能重建，被耗尽的人不能。
ae: Bombed hospitals can be rebuilt. Exhausted people cannot.

t: 一集SNL的错位与谁在付账
te: SNL's Halloween Misfire and Who Pays
a: 当人们把女性身体当作节日装饰，暴力就穿上了万圣节服装。
ae: When a woman's body becomes a costume, violence wears a Halloween mask.

t: 一场没有受害者的选举报道
te: An Election Story With No Victims
a: 人人都在谈代价，却没人问谁在付代价。
ae: Everyone talks about cost. Nobody asks who pays it in bodies.

t: 榜单上的女人，和榜单外的账本
te: A Woman on Top of the Chart, and the Ledger Underneath
a: 女性破纪录的新闻，先问纪录是谁定的。
ae: When a woman breaks a record, first ask who set it.

t: 悼词里的妻子，不在讣告的句号里
te: The Wife Is in the Statement, Not in the Ending
a: 声明把妻子写进陪护，却没写进她自己的余生
ae: The tribute names her at his side, never after

t: 法官拆穿了"恶意"的伪装
te: The Judge Saw Through the "Malice"
a: 起诉书说媒体恶意，法官说起诉书才是制造
ae: The suit cried malice; the judge said the suit was the fabrication.

t: 凌晨四点半的清场
te: The 4:30am Sweep
a: 房租翻倍是市场，帐篷越界是违法
ae: Doubled rents are the market; a tent is illegal.

t: 七个月就合伙买房，这叫浪漫
te: Seven Months In, They Bought a House Together. Call It What It Is.
a: 浪漫叙事给共同资产贴金，把一份财务报表说成爱情
ae: Romance is the label that keeps a balance sheet from looking like one.

t: 她把自己投进了别人的票仓
te: She Voted Herself Into Someone Else's Ballot
a: 站台不是表达，是把定价权交出去
ae: Standing on his stage isn't expression; it's handing over the pricing power.

t: 健身房里的婊子装，谁在定价
te: Who Prices the Whore Outfit at the Gym
a: 男人骂女人穿得像婊子，女人穿回去，这叫反击？
ae: A man calls her outfit whorewear; she wears the word back. That's not a win.

t: 一句脏话，替谁把账结了
te: A Slur, Paid Off by Someone Else
a: 她说出那个词，笑的是观众，不是那个男人
ae: She said the word; the audience laughed; the man who said it first walked away clean.

t: 演到分不清自己是谁，才叫演
te: Losing Yourself Is the Performance
a: 表达一旦被角色接管，演员本人就退场了
ae: When a role takes over your expression, you leave the stage.

t: 保护政治盟友的避难权
te: Asylum for Allies, Passports for Enemies
a: 人道主义是给盟友的，护照是给敌人的。
ae: Humanitarian parole is for allies; the passport is for the enemy.

t: 警棍守着投票箱
te: Batons Guarding the Ballot
a: 删掉一亿三千万个名字，再用盾牌守住解释权。
ae: Erase 130 million names, then guard the explanation with shields.

t: 婚礼是她的，流量是平台的
te: Her Wedding, Their Traffic
a: 一场婚礼被折算成2.5%的涨幅，这就是定价。
ae: A wedding converted into a 2.5% bump: that is what pricing looks like.

t: 推土机碾平的证据
te: The Bulldozed Evidence
a: 推土机翻的不是土，是证据。
ae: The bulldozer isn't turning soil. It's turning evidence.

t: 换个牌照，暴力照旧
te: New Licence, Same Violence
a: 财政大臣换了尺子，赌场换了招牌，输的还是同一个人。
ae: The chancellor changed the ruler; the slot farms changed the sign. The loser is the same person.

t: 一本小说的评分榜，谁在付账
te: A Scoreboard for a Book About Being Farmed
a: 把剥削写成娱乐，读者替它数星星
ae: The exploitation is the entertainment; the readers count the stars.

t: 片场没有紧张，只有定价
te: No Tension on Set, Only a Price
a: 谁有资格定义受害者，谁就握着解释权
ae: Whoever defines the victim owns the explanation.

t: 他不谈中期选举，因为选票不是他的工具
te: He Won't Talk About the Midterms Because Votes Aren't His Tool
a: 宗教动员的终点从来不是选票，是制度本身。
ae: Religious mobilization doesn't end at the ballot. It ends inside the institutions.

t: 偶像工业的账本，从来不记练习生的年龄
te: The Idol Industry's Ledger Never Records a Trainee's Age
a: 四条独立生产线，一台机器没变
ae: Four solo pipelines, one machine unchanged.

t: 一个南瓜头，十年美国梦
te: A Pumpkin Head, Ten Years of America
a: 特朗普和南瓜头同年出道，都靠又响又橙又烦人活着。
ae: Trump and Pumpkins debuted the same year: loud, orange, annoying, and still here.

t: 爱泼斯坦成了竞选广告的弹药
te: Epstein Is Campaign Ammunition Now
a: 受害者被做成广告素材，加害结构原地不动
ae: Victims become ad material; the structure that enabled him stays put.

t: 60比0的半场，谁在为这项运动付账
te: Sixty-Nil at Halftime, and Who Pays for the Growth
a: 一场创纪录的屠杀，被写成了女足的胜利。
ae: A record thrashing got written up as a triumph for women's sport.

t: 夺冠之后，谁在扮演醉鬼
te: After the Title, Who Plays the Drunk
a: 体育明星上综艺，卖的是可以被消费的男性气质
ae: Athletes on late-night TV are selling a masculinity that's easy to consume.

t: 心理健康清单里的定价权
te: The Price Tag on the Pain List
a: 能被讲出来的痛苦，先得被市场定价
ae: Pain gets heard only after the market prices it.

t: 雪景是假的，病是真的
te: The Snow Is Fake. The Sickness Is Real.
a: 一片白色被定价成风景，代价由看不见的人付。
ae: A white landscape gets priced as scenery; the bill goes to people nobody photographs.

t: 联合国要真相，胡塞给沉默
te: The UN Asks for Truth; the Houthis Offer Silence
a: 一个人被关了一年多，死了，家属过了一个月才知道。
ae: A man was held for over a year, died, and his family learned a month later.

t: 一场比赛，十个人的身体被计价
te: A Match Where Ten Bodies Get Priced
a: 职业体育把身体当耗材，伤情通报里没有受伤的人
ae: Pro rugby treats bodies as consumables; the injury report has no injured person in it.

t: 一座凯旋门，谁在给谁立碑
te: An Arch for Whom, a Monument to What
a: 纪念性建筑从来不是审美问题，是谁有权把名字刻进天际线
ae: Monuments are never about taste. They are about who gets to carve a name into the skyline.

t: 排行榜不测量音乐，测量谁有资格被计数
te: The Charts Don't Measure Music. They Measure Who Gets Counted.
a: 一张榜单的入场券，是这个世纪最贵的表达权
ae: A chart's entry ticket is the most expensive form of expression this century sells.

t: 一位演员死了，一部电影才被记起
te: An Actor Died, and Only Then Did the Film Get Remembered
a: 神坛上的男人死了，人们悼念的是他救下的产业，不是他演过的人。
ae: They mourn the man who saved the industry, not the man he played.

t: 爱情时间线是一门生意
te: A Love Timeline Is a Product
a: 把生育写成浪漫，把女人写成奖品
ae: Call it romance, and the cost disappears.

t: 二十四个人的家务，一个人的未来
te: Twenty-Four People Clean the House, One Woman Creates the Future
a: 被写成"未来"的，是把家务外包给二十四个人的能力。
ae: What gets called "the future" is the power to outsource housework to twenty-four people.

t: 灾难没有署名，代价有
te: Disaster Has No Signature. The Cost Does.
a: 先救牛还是先救人，才是紧急状态的真正内容
ae: Who gets saved first—cattle or families—is what the emergency decree actually decides.

t: 节日回来了，抓人的车没走
te: The Festival Came Back. The Raids Didn't Leave.
a: 取消节日的是恐惧，恢复节日的是信任，ICE 还在原地。
ae: Fear canceled the festival; trust restored it; ICE never moved.

t: AI把人推给记者，平台把人推给AI
te: AI Sends People to Journalists, Platforms Send People to AI
a: 客服消失的地方，AI成了唯一的入口，记者成了它虚构的申诉部门。
ae: Where support vanished, AI became the only door—and it invented a newsroom as the appeals desk.

t: 解压玩具不解决压力
te: A $46 Billion Cure for Nothing
a: 把情绪出口做成四十六亿美元的货架，压力本身没人动。
ae: The industry sells an outlet for stress; nobody touches the stress.

t: 把国家拆成公司，把人拆成数据
te: He Wants to Turn the State Into a Corporation
a: 技术威权不是新意识形态，是定价权的换手
ae: Techno-authoritarianism isn't a new ideology. It's a change of ownership.

t: 六天停火，谁在付账
te: Six Days of Ceasefire, and Who Pays
a: 人道走廊是暴力的例外，不是暴力的反面。
ae: A humanitarian corridor is an exception to violence, not its opposite.

t: 九场不胜，教练先谈赛程
te: Nine Without a Win, and the Fixture List Gets the Blame
a: 输球被讲成赛程问题，解释权才是最后的战术。
ae: Losing reframed as scheduling: the last tactic is who narrates the game.

t: 沉默的代价由谁付
te: Who Pays for the Silence
a: 场馆在审查内容，歌手在审查自己，只有观众被要求沉默。
ae: Venues pre-approve the setlist, artists pre-approve themselves, and only the audience is asked to stay quiet.

t: 拳台上没有中立
te: No Neutral Corner
a: 导弹落在机场，拳赛照打，账单由别人付。
ae: Missiles hit the airport. The fight went on. Someone else paid.

t: 六十三亿的账，谁在替谁兜底
te: Who Pays for the $6.3bn Hole
a: 被偷的是币，被定价的是谁的信任
ae: The coins were stolen; the trust was repriced.

t: 一首歌的十五周冠军，和写歌的人
te: Fifteen Weeks at No. 1, and the People Who Wrote It
a: 八个写歌的人夸它没有废音，没人问唱歌的女人拿到了什么
ae: Eight songwriters praise its craft; nobody asks what the woman singing it got.

t: 把尊严演成笑话，才是他的武器
te: He Made Dignity a Joke, and That Was the Weapon
a: 他从不 wink at the camera，所以没人能给他定价
ae: He never winked at the camera, so no one could price him.

t: 一个婊子，一个疯子
te: A Whore and a Madwoman
a: 她争来的是角色，争不来的是谁有资格定义她
ae: She won the audition. She lost the right to define her own character.

t: 从十二楼滑下来，山还在那儿
te: They Rappelled Down a Billboard. The Mountain Is Still There.
a: 把珠峰搬上广告牌，是为了卖票，不是为了纪念
ae: Turning Everest into a billboard is selling tickets, not honoring the dead.

t: 六十三亿的窟窿，谁在补
te: Who Pays for the $6.3bn Hole
a: 公司替用户兜底，用户替公司记账
ae: The company covers the loss; the users cover the company

t: 榜单是尺子，也是货架
te: The Chart Is a Ruler and a Shelf
a: 排名从来不是中性的，它给表达定价。
ae: A ranking is never neutral. It prices expression.

t: 排行榜是定价权，不是音乐
te: A Chart Is Pricing Power, Not Music
a: 谁定义伟大，谁就定义谁值得被听见
ae: Whoever defines greatness decides who gets heard.

t: 选票算数，人却不算
te: The Votes Count, the Voters Don't
a: 19个席位进了账本，投票的人被叫作恐怖分子
ae: Nineteen seats in the ledger; the people who cast them, called terrorists.

t: 片场和气，账算在别处
te: Set Harmony, Books Elsewhere
a: 把受害者说成施暴者，是最好用的叙事武器。
ae: Calling the victim the perpetrator is the oldest narrative weapon there is.

t: 五百个公民被国家抓走
te: Five Hundred Citizens, Zero on the Books
a: 政府说没有，五百个人身上有手铐。
ae: The government says it doesn't detain citizens. Five hundred people have the handcuffs to prove otherwise.

t: 票房七十三万，先骂影评人
te: $725,000, and the Critics Are the Problem
a: 解释权打不过票房，就先取消影评人的资格。
ae: When you can't win the argument, disqualify the people making it.

t: 换把尺子，工厂就回来了
te: Change the Ruler, the Factories Come Home
a: AI救制造业，救的是估值，不是工人。
ae: AI won't revive manufacturing. It will revive a valuation.

t: 骂影评人救不了票房
te: Insulting Critics Won't Save the Box Office
a: 解释权抢不回来，票房也抢不回来。
ae: You can't win back the box office by seizing the narrative.

t: AO3 停摆四周，谁在付账
te: AO3 Goes Dark for Four Weeks, and Someone Pays
a: 一个由女性无偿劳动撑起来的免费库，停机时连数据库有没有被偷都说不准。
ae: A free library built on women's unpaid labor can't even say whether its database was stolen.

t: 反转不是叙事，是按钮
te: The Twist Isn't the Story. It's the Button.
a: 最好的反转，是让你手里的控制器突然变沉
ae: The best twist makes the controller in your hands suddenly heavier.

t: 被骂神经病的女人，看对了
te: The Women They Called Crazy Were Right
a: 先把她叫疯，再怪她没说服你。
ae: First call her hysterical, then blame her for not convincing you.

t: 赛马场上的钱与马
te: Money and Horses at the Track
a: 马跑得再快，也跑不出资本给它画的圈。
ae: The horse runs fast, but never out of the circle capital drew for it.

t: 十万块的私人飞机，他替你坐了
te: A $100K Private Jet, Flown on Your Dime
a: 竞选经费买的不是机票，是阶级的入场券
ae: Campaign cash doesn't buy flights. It buys a seat in the owning class.

t: 投票站被砍掉三分之一
te: They Cut a Third of the Polling Sites
a: 他们关掉的是投票站，改的是谁能被算作选民
ae: They didn't close polling places. They redrew who counts as a voter.

t: 法庭之争，谁在定义法治
te: Who Gets to Define the Rule of Law
a: 解释权的争夺被写成了法治危机
ae: A fight over interpretive power dressed up as a rule-of-law crisis.

t: 一个老人穿拖鞋散步，成了新闻
te: An Old Man in Slippers Is News
a: 消失的不是他，是允许老人退休的叙事
ae: What disappeared is not him, but the right to stop performing

t: 庞氏骗局的信用来自一枚勋章
te: The Ponzi's Credit Was a Medal
a: 假的最优解表达，是把军装和执照当信用抵押。
ae: Fake optimal expression: pawn the uniform and the license as collateral.

t: 罗琳保住了别人的饭碗，也保住了自己的叙事
te: Rowling Kept His Job. She Kept Her Story, Too.
a: 她不夺人饭碗，只夺人身份，前者被说成美德
ae: She won't take your job, only your legal existence. The first is called grace.

t: 一张榜单，一场女性的内战
te: A Chart That Stages a War Among Women
a: 十个人争十个位置，这就是定量空间。
ae: Ten slots, ten women fighting for them. That's a fixed quantity.

t: 政变不需要坦克，只需要一份行政令
te: A Coup Needs No Tanks, Just an Executive Order
a: 先夺解释权，再夺选票，顺序从来如此
ae: Seize explanation first, ballots second. The order never changes.

t: 钢铁废墟上的体面，谁买单
te: A Steel Mill's Ghost, Priced Up
a: 保留厂房外壳，抹掉的是钢厂工人
ae: Keep the frame, erase the workers.

t: 海峡重开，谁的船先过
te: The Strait Reopens, Whose Ships Go First
a: 霍尔木兹的开关，从来不是德黑兰一个人拧的。
ae: The Hormuz switch was never Tehran's alone to flip.

t: 衣服不是女人的琐事
te: Clothes Are Not Women's Busywork
a: 把服装部当成女人部门，是元暴力最日常的一次分红。
ae: Calling costume "a woman's department" is meta-violence collecting its daily dividend.

t: 她说要退场，行业早让她退场
te: She Says She's Leaving. The Industry Left First.
a: 不是她演不动了，是没人再让她演。
ae: She didn't run out of range. They stopped writing it.

t: 一千三百字的表演，没有一句是真的
te: 1,318 Words of Performance, Not One True
a: 两个男人互相扮演受害者，代价由不在场的人付
ae: Two men play victim; the bill goes to everyone offstage

t: 变装皇后唱音乐剧，排名第几不重要
te: Ranking Drag Queens Singing Musicals Misses the Point
a: 男人扮女人拿奖，女人扮女人没奖
ae: Men playing women win awards; women playing themselves don't.

t: 好莱坞算好了她什么时候过期
te: Hollywood Already Set Her Expiration Date
a: 她说要退场，其实是场子先撤了灯
ae: She calls it an ending; the room turned off the lights first

t: 她替女人省下十年，也替自己赚了一笔
te: She Gave Women a Decade. She Also Gave Herself a Position.
a: 黑框警告拆掉了，持股人的利益没拆
ae: The black box came off; the shareholder's stake stayed on.

t: 七不是新常态，是旧账
te: Seven Isn't the New Normal. It's the Bill.
a: 把利率叫新常态，是把代价说成天气。
ae: Calling 7% the new normal turns a bill into weather.

t: 爱丽丝被锁在旧主机里
te: Alice Is Locked Inside Old Consoles
a: 文化产品的死活，由版权方一句话决定
ae: Whether a cultural work lives or dies is decided by whoever holds the rights.

t: 坏室友的忏悔录，谁在替谁开脱
te: The Bad Roommate Confessional
a: 每一条忏悔都在给一个更小的房间开脱
ae: Every confession is a smaller room built to hide a bigger one.

t: 撞色回潮，谁在为快乐定价
te: Color Blocking Is Back. Who's Pricing the Joy?
a: 品味没有高下，定价权有。
ae: Taste has no hierarchy. Pricing does.

t: 停火换来的不只是一车人
te: A Truce Buys One Busload, Not Peace
a: 停火不是和平，是暴力暂时让出的一条缝
ae: A ceasefire is not peace; it is violence briefly stepping aside.

t: AI 没有变强，只是把门挨个拧了一遍
te: AI Didn't Get Smarter. It Just Turned Every Doorknob
a: 互联网一直很脆，AI 只是把门挨个拧了一遍
ae: The internet was always dry tinder. AI just turned every doorknob.

t: 三十八个人漂在海上，荷兰说很少见
te: 38 People Adrift, and the Netherlands Calls It Rare
a: 船没有马达，人没有救生衣，解释权在岸上
ae: No motor, no life vests, and the explanation stays on shore.

t: 一句脏话的定价权
te: The Price of One F-Bomb
a: 他演了反派，观众却在为他鼓掌
ae: He played the villain, and the audience applauded.

t: 悼词里的男人，和没被写进去的女人
te: The Men in the Eulogy, the Woman Left Out
a: 一篇悼词写满了男性之间的爱与传承，妻子只是被照顾的那个。
ae: A tribute full of men loving men; the wife is only a verb.

t: 凯旋门装得下狙击手，装不下堵车
te: An Arch for Snipers, Not for Traffic
a: 一座纪念凯旋的拱门，先凯旋的是施工队。
ae: A triumphal arch's first victory is over the construction schedule.

t: 她的未婚夫替她说话，她就没话了
te: Her Fiancé Speaks for Her, So She Doesn't
a: 当一个女人的政治立场由未婚夫代讲，她已经在自己的竞选里出局。
ae: When a man narrates a woman's politics, she has already left her own race.

t: 万圣节加更，谁在付代价
te: A Halloween Surprise, Priced in Fear
a: 一部剧的惊喜，是一群孩子的恐惧被定价
ae: A surprise drop is attention management dressed as a gift

t: 用程序正义打程序正义
te: Fixing the Court by Breaking It
a: 没人提法院里那些案子，也没人提谁在为这场拉锯付代价。
ae: Nobody in this story mentions the cases inside the court, or who pays for the standoff.

t: 未婚夫替她说话，她替未婚夫圆场
te: Her Fiancé Speaks, She Explains
a: 她的政治立场被一个三个月前才出现的男人代写了。
ae: Her politics got rewritten by a man who showed up three months ago.

t: 十亿诉状，只值一张生日卡
te: A Billion-Dollar Suit, a Birthday Card
a: 法官把诉讼打回原形，受害者的名字仍没出现
ae: The judge threw out the suit; the victims' names never appeared.

t: 特洛伊木马不是骗局
te: The Trojan Horse Was Never a Trick
a: 木马是武器化的表达，工匠只谈工艺，不谈谁被烧死。
ae: The horse is weaponized expression. The artisans discuss craft, never who burns.

t: 油价的决定权不在产油国手里
te: The Oil Price Was Decided Before the Meeting
a: 七国开会定配额，配额早被战争定了
ae: Seven states set quotas; the war had already set them.

t: 用强奸受害者的母亲打强奸受害者
te: A Rapist's Defender, Hired to Call the Victim a Liar
a: 保护儿童是口号，消费儿童是生意
ae: Protecting children is the slogan; consuming one is the business.

t: 纪念一个演员，别只纪念他的角色
te: Eulogies Remember the Roles, Not the Violence
a: 把家暴幸存者写成脚注，才是这篇讣闻真正的问题
ae: The one line about domestic violence is there to decorate the obituary, not to confront it.

t: 童星片场安全，是成年人给的
te: A Safe Set Is an Adult's Choice
a: 一个成年人对孩子不摆架子，本身就是稀缺新闻
ae: An adult who treats children as equals is treated as news.

t: 反抗的剧本里，谁在演主角
te: Who Plays the Lead in the Rebellion Script
a: 他们写好了反抗剧本，却只把人民当群众演员
ae: They wrote the resistance playbook and cast the people as extras.

t: 一个男人穿着拖鞋消失了
te: A Man in Slippers Disappeared
a: 消失的不是他，是镜头不再对准他
ae: He didn't vanish. The camera just stopped pointing at him.

t: 她收下那条管道的钱
te: She Took the Pipeline's Money
a: 反抗的叙事被收编，从来不用打，只要收购。
ae: A rebellion gets absorbed not by force, but by a check.

t: 他告不倒的，是他自己的信
te: The Letter He Can't Sue Away
a: 十亿索赔被驳回，但解释权还在他手里
ae: A billion-dollar suit dismissed. The power to name facts stays contested.

t: 反数据中心的人，正靠数据中心赚钱
te: They Protest Data Centers, They Own Them
a: 反AI数据中心的政客，自己就是股东。
ae: The politicians attacking AI data centers are shareholders in them.

t: 一千次违规，零次罚款
te: A Thousand Violations, Zero Fines
a: 监管者不是没看见，是不敢碰。
ae: The regulator saw everything. It chose not to touch.

t: 红牌不是命，是结构
te: A Red Card Is Not Fate, It's Structure
a: 一场比赛里，红牌被读成命运，帅位被读成运气。
ae: A red card read as fate, a job read as luck.

t: 埃博拉没疫苗，但有人先撤了
te: No Vaccine, But Someone Got a Plane
a: 疫情里最先被保护的，从来不是最先被感染的人。
ae: In an outbreak, the first protected are never the first infected.

t: 谁在为尴尬定价
te: Who Sets the Price of Awkward
a: 尴尬不是情感问题，是空间与解释权的分配问题。
ae: Awkwardness isn't a feeling. It's a fight over space and who gets to explain it.

t: 四成名字根本不在选民册上
te: Four in Ten Names Aren't Even on the Rolls
a: 名单错了不可怕，可怕的是名单本身就是目的
ae: A wrong list isn't the failure. The list is the point.

t: 又一场车库神话，谁在付账
te: Another Garage Myth, and Who Pays for It
a: 每一个白手起家的少年背后，都有一张没被写进报表的账单。
ae: Behind every teenage founder story is a bill that never made it into the revenue line.

t: 冻结一半，也算胜利？
te: Half Frozen Is Still a Heist
a: 被冻结的是稳定币，逃掉的是真钱。
ae: The stablecoins got frozen. The real money walked.

t: 万圣节片单里的女人
te: The Women in the Halloween Watchlist
a: 恐怖片单列了十几部，女人的处境只出现在一句黄腔里
ae: A dozen horror picks, and a woman's situation appears only as a dirty joke.

t: 礼貌是办公室战争的伪装
te: Politeness Is the Camouflage of Office War
a: 被动攻击是弱者在规则内的武器，代价是同事成了敌人
ae: Passive aggression is the weak's weapon inside the rules; the cost is that colleagues become enemies.

t: 一部传记片，两个女人的名字
te: A Biopic With Two Roles for Women
a: Snoop 的故事里，女人只有母亲和妻子两个格子
ae: In Snoop's story, women get two slots: mother and wife.

t: 换尺子的人，和造尺子的人
te: The Ones Changing the Ruler, and the Ones Making It
a: 开源模型的胜负，先看谁在定义"领先"
ae: In open models, whoever defines "leading" wins first.

t: 被冻结的资金，解冻的电影
te: The Films They Froze, and the Man Who Unfroze Them
a: 他举报了分钱的共谋者，于是共谋者冻结了他的电影。
ae: He reported the people splitting the money. They froze his films.

t: 他杀了一个女孩，然后成了教育素材
te: He Killed a Girl, and It Became Teaching Material
a: 一部关于杀女孩的剧，最安全的下场是被学校免费播放。
ae: A show about a boy stabbing a girl ends up free in schools. That's the safest possible fate.

t: 搜出的炸弹与没写出的名字
te: The Bombs Were Removed, the Story Wasn't
a: 爆炸物被清走了，解释权还留在原处
ae: The devices are in evidence bags. The narrative stays where it was.

t: 一个不存在的人签了所有人的解雇信
te: A Man Who Didn't Exist Signed Everyone's Termination Letter
a: 程序不是形式，程序是暴力的分配权。
ae: Procedure isn't formality. Procedure is who gets to allocate violence.

t: 丑萌不是美学，是定价权
te: Ugly-Cute Isn't an Aesthetic, It's Pricing Power
a: 谁定义丑，谁就定义了谁该被看
ae: Whoever defines ugly also defines who deserves to be seen.

t: 竞选广告是一门制造真实的生意
te: A Campaign Ad Is a Business of Manufacturing Reality
a: 政治表达被武器化时，选民拿到的不是承诺，是素材。
ae: When political expression is weaponized, voters get footage, not promises.

t: 谁在给选举结果定价
te: Who Gets to Price an Election
a: 选举结果的合法性，由解释权决定，不由选票决定。
ae: The legitimacy of a result is set by who interprets it, not by the votes.

t: 输掉四百万票，飞往德州
te: Four Million Votes Down, Headed for Texas
a: 他们把竞选当提款，把败选当登机牌。
ae: They treat the campaign as an ATM and the loss as a boarding pass.

t: 法院拆穿的不是假新闻，是假起诉
te: The Court Didn't Debunk Fake News. It Debunked a Fake Lawsuit.
a: 他起诉的不是诽谤，是让报纸闭嘴的成本。
ae: He didn't sue for defamation. He sued to make publishing expensive.

t: AI 先吃掉的是穷人的手机
te: AI Eats the Cheap Phone First
a: 最便宜的智能机消失了，AI 的账单由最穷的人付。
ae: The cheapest smartphones are vanishing, and the poorest pay AI's bill.

t: 八十一岁还在巡演，谁在数他的命
te: Eighty-One and Still Touring, Whose Life Is Being Counted
a: 摇滚神话把衰老写成敬业，代价是那个人的身体
ae: Rock myth sells immortality; the bill arrives in one man's body.

t: 大都会歌剧院的第一部女性委约歌剧
te: The Met's First Opera Commissioned From a Woman
a: 历史性突破被写成了脚注，这才是元暴力。
ae: A historic first, filed as a parenthetical. That is meta-violence.

t: 一部吃人的电影，没人付代价
te: A Feast Where Nobody Pays
a: 所有盛宴都有人被端上桌，问题是谁。
ae: Every banquet has someone served on the table. The question is who.

t: “可负担住房”是个词，不是一个家
te: 'Affordable Housing' Is a Phrase, Not a Home
a: 他们争的不是建不建，是谁有资格住在自己家附近
ae: They're not fighting over whether to build. They're fighting over who gets to live near what they already own.

t: 改选票规则，不改谁被选掉
te: Changing the Ballot Rules, Not Who Gets Eliminated
a: 特朗普告阿拉斯加，争的不是计票，是计票的解释权
ae: Trump's suit against Alaska isn't about counting votes. It's about who gets to certify them.

t: 游戏里没有生活，只有清单
te: No Life in the Game, Only a Checklist
a: 把日常打包成待办项，是玩家替资本写的情书。
ae: Packaging daily life as to-dos is a love letter players write for capital.

t: 公主还在，剧没了
te: The Princess Stays, the Series Doesn't
a: 先砍掉剧集，再宣布特辑，这叫止损不叫兑现
ae: Cancel the show, announce a special: that's damage control, not a promise kept

t: AO3 停摆，谁在替它收租
te: AO3 Is Down. Who's Renting Out the Corpse?
a: 免费的同人站倒下时，付费的替代品立刻来收尸。
ae: When the free archive falls, the paid substitutes come to collect.

t: 假发是给选角导演看的
te: The Wig Was for the Casting Director
a: 他们要看的是摘下假发的那个男人，不是假发。
ae: They wanted to see the man without the hairpiece, not the hairpiece.

t: 一千名联邦监票员和四百英尺
te: A Thousand Federal Monitors and Four Hundred Feet
a: 当监票变成恐吓，选举就成了表演
ae: When poll-watching becomes intimidation, the election becomes theater.

t: 他卖的不是技术，是解释权
te: He Wasn't Selling Tech. He Was Selling the Story.
a: 勒索者被起诉了，帮忙赎人的那位也被起诉了。
ae: The ransom was paid. So was the man who said he never paid it.

t: 三百七十六人开会，二百七十九人到场
te: 376 Were Named. 279 Showed Up.
a: 缺席的不是人，是忠诚的计量单位
ae: The absences are not people. They are units of loyalty.

t: 苹果的尺子，量了十年才量到手指
te: Apple's Ruler Took Ten Years to Reach a Finger
a: 不是触屏变对了，是苹果终于把评价标准换成了自己
ae: The touchscreen didn't become right. Apple just changed the ruler to its own.

t: 极化不是病，是有人不想让你看清谁在共谋
te: Polarization Is Not the Disease. It's the Distraction.
a: 把极化说成心理本能，是在替结构免责
ae: Calling polarization human nature lets the structure off the hook.

t: 拆掉电视的锁，也拆掉别人的门
te: Pick the Lock, Kick the Door
a: 同一把锤子，砸锁是解放，砸门是抢劫。
ae: Same hammer: crack your own lock, kick down someone else's door.

t: 万圣节变装是场筛选考试
te: Halloween Costuming Is an Entrance Exam
a: 变装越冷门，越是在给圈层定价
ae: The more niche the costume, the more it prices the circle.

t: 金发不是傻子的证明，是商品
te: Blonde Isn't Proof You're Smart. It's Merchandise.
a: 扮演偶像的扮演，仍然是扮演
ae: Playing an icon's play is still playing.

t: 保密和解是封口费的学名
te: A Confidential Settlement Is Just Hush Money With Better Paperwork
a: 钱到账了，解释权还在原地
ae: The money moved. The narrative didn't.

t: Who Is This Unity For?
a: The man who backed the loser now teaches unity.

t: 一件T恤和一条广告，谁在动谁的票
te: A T-shirt and an Ad, and Who Moves Whose Votes
a: 一件T恤是表达，一条广告是武器化表达。
ae: A T-shirt is expression. An attack ad is weaponized expression.

t: 八个名字，一场颁奖礼的定价逻辑
te: Eight Names and the Pricing Desk of an Award
a: 奖项不是评价，是给表达定价的柜台。
ae: An award is not a judgment. It is a counter that prices expression.

t: 估值是自己写的剧本
te: The Valuation Is the Script
a: 钱没少要，只是尺子换了。
ae: The ask shrank; the ruler didn't move.

t: 一部关于向上爬的音乐剧，和它不敢说的地面
te: A Musical About Rising, and the Ground It Won't Name
a: 他们为一个不敢说出口的名字欢呼，这就是全部的政治。
ae: They cheered for a name left unsaid. That's the whole politics of it.

t: 把睡前故事拍成三部曲，谁在付账
te: They Turned a Bedtime Story Into a Trilogy. Who Paid for It?
a: 童话的框架被拆了，因为史诗比哄睡好卖。
ae: The fairy-tale frame was dismantled because epic sells better than lullaby.

t: 一个男人自曝被包养，热搜笑了
te: A Man Admits He Was Kept, and Everyone Laughs
a: 他把被定价的经历讲成段子，代价被笑声吞掉。
ae: He turned being priced into a punchline, and the cost vanished into the laughter.

t: 增长是尺子，不是能力
te: Growth Is a Ruler, Not a Capacity
a: 换一把尺子，不等于把日子过好了
ae: Changing the ruler doesn't mean anyone's life got better.

t: 把否决权写进法案里
te: Write the Veto Into the Statute
a: 选民投过一次票，议会就把那次投票变成可撤销的。
ae: Voters passed it once; the legislature made that vote revocable.

t: 海伦·米伦爱刀，谁爱海伦·米伦
te: Helen Mirren Loves Knives. Who Loves Helen Mirren?
a: 一个女演员被允许演天才，前提是天才得是个怪人
ae: An actress may play a genius, if the genius is first made a freak.

t: 十七个席位，一张不存在的选票
te: Seventeen Seats, One Erased Ballot
a: 选票可以增加，人可以被宣布不存在。
ae: You can add seats. You can still declare a people nonexistent.

t: 一条腰封，两种人生
te: A Cummerbund, Two Lives
a: 男装借来的单品成了女性的新功课
ae: A menswear hand-me-down becomes women's new homework.

t: 医保停摆不算暴力
te: Gridlock Is Not the Violence
a: 他们怕的不是停摆，是有人来查账
ae: What they fear isn't a shutdown. It's an audit.

t: 他靠模仿特朗普买下一张国会门票
te: He Bought a Congressional Seat With a Trump Impression
a: 当一个男人把无耻做成品牌，市场会替他定价。
ae: When a man turns shamelessness into a brand, the market prices it for him.

t: 谁在替爆炸案买单
te: Who Pays for the Blast
a: 26条命换来一张合影，这就是共谋的价格。
ae: Twenty-six lives bought one photo op. That's the price of complicity.

t: 钱没有立场，只有入口
te: Money Has No Party, Only Entry Points
a: PAC 不买候选人，买的是认知入口的租约。
ae: A PAC doesn't buy candidates. It leases cognitive entry points.

t: 双标不是审美问题，是定价权
te: The Double Standard Is Not Taste. It's Pricing Power.
a: 同一个年龄差，男人叫本事，女人叫物种
ae: Same age gap: for a man it's an achievement, for a woman it's a species.

t: 五百亿蒸发，尺子没换
te: Half a Trillion Gone, Same Ruler
a: 估值是叙事，不是能力。
ae: Valuation is narrative, not capability.

t: 道歉信里没有被打的人
te: The Apology Has No One in It Who Got Hurt
a: 她向被自己吓到的人道歉，唯独没向被踢伤的人道歉。
ae: She apologized to those she frightened. Not to those she kicked.

t: 投票权赢了，地图还没赢
te: They Won the Map, Not the Pencil
a: 法院把选区还回来了，但改地图的权力还在对方手里
ae: The court handed back a district. The power to draw them never moved.

t: 他们把尺子砸了，人还在量
te: They Broke the Ruler, People Still Measure
a: 法律被拆掉之后，投票成了唯一的表达
ae: With the law dismantled, voting becomes the only expression left

t: 读书不是为了穿在身上
te: Reading Is Not for Wearing
a: 把小说做成内衣，卖的是身份，不是故事
ae: They turned a novel into lingerie and sold identity, not story.

t: 一个人从厨房摔死，写成了一则脚注
te: A Man Died Slipping in His Kitchen. It Got Written as a Footnote.
a: 死者的年龄有两个版本，死因只有一个版本
ae: Two versions of his age. One version of how he died.

t: 没人合影的G20，没人买单的战争
te: No Group Photo, No One Paying for the Wars
a: 联合公报缺席，不是外交失败，是共谋者懒得再演。
ae: The missing communique isn't a diplomatic failure. It's the co-conspirators no longer bothering to perform.

te: A Crepe Priced by the Cold War
a: 小麦不是台湾的主粮，是冷战的筹码。

te: One Fine Shuts a Newsroom

ae: Authoritarians erase memory, then sell you a documentary about memory.

t: 保护伞的骨架是Starlink
te: The Canopy's Frame Is Starlink
a: 联盟叙事越宏大，越要看谁在替它拧阀门。
ae: The grander the alliance narrative, the more you ask who turns the valve.

t: 死亡不是卖点，遗产才是
te: Death Isn't the Product. The Legacy Is.
a: 她把死亡写成了遗产，遗产里却没有女儿的名字
ae: She turned death into an inheritance—one with no byline for her daughter.

t: 两千人换一条绕地球的路
te: Two Thousand People, One Absurd Route
a: 撤离不是和平，是给围城开的一扇侧门
ae: Evacuation is not peace; it is a side door in a siege.

t: 效率归自己，账单归客户
te: Efficiency for the Firm, the Bill for the Client
a: 省下的时间归律师，没省下的钱归客户
ae: The saved hours go to the lawyer; the unsaved money stays with the client.

t: 检方替他数了五千个
te: The Prosecutor Counted His Five Thousand
a: 他管女人叫消遣，检方只能证明她们不是自愿的消遣。
ae: He called women amusements. The court can only prove they weren't willing ones.

t: 他们说不知道，这就是共谋
te: They Say They Didn't Know. That's the Conspiracy.
a: 每个男人都说自己只是路过，而路是他们一起铺的。
ae: Every man says he just happened to be there. The road was paved by all of them.

t: 十二人中枪，一个无辜者蹲了五个月
te: Twelve Shot, One Innocent Man Jailed for Five Months
a: 抓错人不是失误，是系统必须交出的一个名字
ae: A wrongful arrest isn't a mistake. It's a name the system had to produce.

t: 读书一百本，读不出谁在付账
te: One Hundred Novels, Not One Question of Who Pays
a: 她读懂了小说的技法，没读懂小说替谁说话
ae: She learned the craft of the novel. She never learned whom the novel was built to serve.

t: 鬼故事里关着的是人
te: The Ghost Story Is Hiding the Prisoner
a: 把囚禁讲成闹鬼，是替施暴者保管记忆。
ae: Turning imprisonment into a haunting is how the jailer keeps the record.

t: 净水器测评里的水，谁在买单
te: The Water in the Water-Filter Test
a: 实验室的自来水脏，是因为写字楼没人替它争取
ae: The lab's tap water is dirty because nobody in that building fought for it

t: 一场凶案，谁的名字被写掉了
te: A Murder Story, and a Name That Got Overwritten
a: 报道写了他用出生名，然后继续叫他Daniel Jones
ae: The story notes he prefers his birth name, then keeps calling him Daniel Jones.

t: 嫁给柳条的男人，和嫁给丈夫的女人
te: She Married a Wicker Man; He Married a Wife
a: 柳条丈夫是幻想，婚姻共谋才是现实
ae: The wicker husband is a fantasy. The marital co-conspiracy is the reality.

t: 庞贝的衣柜，谁的日常
te: Pompeii's Wardrobe, Whose Daily Life
a: 被埋起来的是日常，被命名的是主人
ae: What was buried is daily life; what got named is the owner.

t: 瘦子变多了，话却变少了
te: Everyone Is Thin, Nobody Says So
a: 身体积极死了，留下的是更精密的定价权
ae: Body positivity died and left behind a more precise pricing machine.

t: 他们先杀记者，再杀报馆
te: They Killed the Journalists, Then the Newsroom
a: 解释权被没收时，连'战争'两个字都要打星号
ae: When the state owns the story, even the word 'war' becomes asterisks.

t: 一封信在伦敦转了一圈
te: A Letter That Circled London
a: 伦敦警察厅把一桩涉嫌性侵的指控当成了王室家务事
ae: The Met treated an abuse allegation as a family matter.

t: 育儿假里长出的第二职业
te: A Second Career Grown in Maternity Leave
a: 母职惩罚的反面，是她把家里的缝隙改成了工作室
ae: The flip side of the motherhood penalty: she turned a gap at home into a studio

t: 最吓人的从来不是鬼
te: The Scariest Thing Was Never the Ghost
a: 恐怖片里的怪物是假的，片单里的男人是真的。
ae: The monsters in horror films are fake. The men on this list are real.

t: 处决失败后的痛，谁来定价
te: Who Prices the Pain of a Botched Killing
a: 国家杀人失手，疼的是她的身体，被讨论的却是程序。
ae: The state failed to kill her; the review will fix the needle, not the right to use it.

t: 他打破了沉默，沉默本身才是凶手
te: He Broke the Silence; the Silence Was the Crime
a: 家暴的共谋链上，医生、警察、邻居都在，他选择不共谋。
ae: On the chain of complicity, doctors, police and neighbours all stood. He stepped off it.

t: 把人挡在门外，再宣布没有这个人
te: Bar the Door, Then Declare the Man Absent
a: 禁掉的不只是一个人，而是他对解释权的使用
ae: What was banned is not a person but his claim on interpretation.

t: 流亡者的加冕，只维持了58分钟
te: A Coronation in Exile, 58 Minutes Long
a: 自封总统的人，连国徽都还停在1967年
ae: The man who crowned himself couldn't even update the coat of arms.

t: 七十六支球队，零个新故事
te: 76 Teams, Zero New Stories
a: 扩军不是让更多人有机会，是让组织者多收一轮钱
ae: Expansion isn't more access. It's one more round of revenue for the organizers.

t: 被放走的四十四岁
te: Let Go at Forty-Four
a: 一个运动员的自我怀疑，是结构暴力的私人收据
ae: An athlete's self-doubt is the private receipt of structural violence.

t: 谁的工作才算工作
te: Whose Job Counts as a Job
a: 被砍掉的岗位不配上头条，因为砍它们的人不用还债。
ae: The cuts that vanish from headlines are the ones whose makers never pay for them.

t: 假化妆品里的汞，和真化妆品里的账
te: Mercury in the Fakes, Ledger in the Real
a: 假货卖的是廉价，真货卖的是你不敢不买
ae: Counterfeits sell cheap; the real ones sell the fear of not buying

t: 没有评判的舞池
te: A Dance Floor Without a Score
a: 表达一旦不被定价，人就从商品变回人。
ae: When expression stops being priced, people stop being products.

t: 当「赢」被重新定义
te: When Winning Gets Redefined
a: 需要46分的奇迹，本身就是失败。
ae: Needing a 46-point miracle is itself the failure.

t: 拖行一英里的不是车，是选择
te: What Dragged Him a Mile Was a Choice
a: 他知道人在车下，还是踩了油门。
ae: He knew the man was under the car. He drove anyway.

t: 万亿军购买来的不是保护，是靶子
te: A Trillion Buys You a Target, Not Protection
a: 买来的保护从来不是保护，是共谋的分成。
ae: Purchased protection is never protection. It's a cut of the conspiracy.

t: 战争账单上的龙虾
te: The Lobster on the War Bill
a: 普通人付代价，解释权在共谋者手里
ae: Ordinary people pay; the co-conspirators hold the解释权.

t: 柳条不是柳条，男人不是男人
te: Willow Isn't Willow, a Man Isn't a Man
a: 一个会脸红的编织物，比会编织的人更像主角。
ae: A blushing weave gets more screen time than the people who weave.

t: 电话集会救不了饥饿罢工
te: Phone Rallies Don't Feed a Hunger Strike
a: 一场取消的集会是表演，一场饥饿罢工是暴力
ae: A cancelled rally is theater; a hunger strike is violence.

t: 肥胖不是意志力问题
te: Obesity Is Not a Willpower Problem
a: 把肥胖写成个人选择，政府就能永远只交报告
ae: Call obesity a personal choice, and the state only ever has to deliver reports.

t: 他们把强奸案做成了竞选广告
te: They Turned a Rape Case Into a Campaign Ad
a: 受害者的伤口不是素材，除非有人一直允许它被这么用。
ae: A survivor's wound is not material — unless someone keeps letting it be used.

t: 国防合同的抵消，是笔生意
te: Offsets Are a Business Deal, Not Security
a: 把军费说成就业，是给暴力定价的第一步
ae: Calling military spending jobs is the first step in pricing violence.

t: 站台不点名，共谋有分寸
te: They Endorsed Him Without Saying His Name
a: 民主党拥抱的不是他，是密歇根那50%
ae: The party embraced the 50%, not the man.

t: 砍掉热泵补贴，先砍的是谁的家
te: Cutting Heat Pump Subsidies Cuts Someone's Home First
a: 把账单转给纳税人，先挨冻的不是财相
ae: Shifting the bill to taxpayers: the chancellor stays warm.

t: 警察终于开始查了，可谁在查警察
te: The Police Are Finally Investigating. Who Investigates the Police?
a: 调查刚起步，解释权早已被垄断
ae: The inquiry just started; the narrative was seized long ago.

t: 先定义改善，再谈改善
te: Define Improvement First
a: 换尺子不换能力，是这套政府最熟练的手艺
ae: Changing the ruler, not the capability — the oldest trick in the book.

t: 把莎士比亚带上飞船的人
te: The Man Who Brought Shakespeare Aboard
a: 一个演员的全部技艺，是让权力看起来像修养。
ae: An actor's whole craft is making power look like cultivation.

t: 讣告也是一种剧本
te: An Obituary Is Also a Script
a: 银幕上的君王，银幕外的剧本，谁在写谁
ae: A king on screen, a script off it — who writes whom

t: 军队不是稀缺品，服役才是
te: The Army Is Not Scarce. Serving Is.
a: 他们嘲笑的不是孙兴慜没当兵，是有人可以不当兵。
ae: They aren't mocking Son for skipping service. They're mocking that anyone can.

t: 权力往下放，放到谁手里
te: Power Moves Down. To Whose Hands?
a: 分权的话术在换尺子，不在换能力
ae: The rhetoric of devolution changes the ruler, not the capacity.

t: 非洲杯改回两年一届，谁在付账
te: Afcon Goes Back to Two Years. Who Pays?
a: 赛程表的每一次改动，都是一次定价。
ae: Every schedule change is a price being set.

t: 孤独被标价八十五万
te: Solitude, Priced at £850,000
a: 没有邻居不是诗，是资产定价的修辞
ae: No neighbours isn't poetry. It's how property copy prices isolation.

t: 围城不只是断水断粮
te: A Siege That Rewrites People
a: 先改身份，再改课程，最后改人。
ae: First cut the water. Then rewrite the curriculum. Then remake the people.

t: 饺子是全人类的，包饺子的是谁
te: Everyone Eats Dumplings. Who Makes Them?
a: 把饺子写成人类大同，顺手把包饺子的人藏了
ae: A universalism that never asks who folds the wrappers is just a well-fed one.

t: 七百万买一个悬念
te: £7m Buys a Cliffhanger
a: 七百万不是申奥，是买一张选票的定金
ae: Seven million isn't an Olympic bid. It's a deposit on a vote.

t: 预算不够激进，怪伊朗战争
te: Not Radical Enough, Blame the War
a: 说'空间不够'的人，正是划出这个空间的人
ae: The man saying there was no room is the one who drew the room.

t: 两次撞车之间，少掉的那份安全
te: Between Two Crashes, the Safety That Wasn't There
a: 同一线路一年两撞，不是天灾，是差额。
ae: Two crashes on one line in nine months isn't fate. It's the gap nobody filled.

t: 住在恐怖片里，谁在付房租
te: The House Is the Product, She Pays the Rent
a: 一栋被电影赋值的房子，住进去的人也在被它定价。
ae: A house priced by a movie also prices whoever lives in it.

t: 六十三亿美元蒸发，没人被抢
te: $6.3bn Vanishes, Nobody Robbed
a: 币被偷走时，被偷的人还在被感谢。
ae: When the money is stolen, the stolen are thanked for their patience.

t: 七百个狗屎桶和一场财政表演
te: Seven Hundred Bins and a Fiscal Pantomime
a: 砍掉十万的桶，掩盖两千六百万的税。
ae: Cut £100k of bins to hide £26m of untaxed revenue.

t: 免税额涨了，谁在付这笔钱
te: The Allowance Went Up. Who Pays for It?
a: 把税免掉，不等于把压力免掉
ae: A tax break is not a pressure break.

t: 不肯算的账，就是暴力本身
te: The Uncounted Ledger Is the Violence
a: 拒绝公布影响评估，是把无家可归者从统计里删掉
ae: Refusing to publish the impact assessment deletes the homeless from the statistics.

t: 一件毛绒外套的价格表
te: The Price List on a Fluffy Coat
a: 品味不是自由，是标价。
ae: Taste isn't freedom. It's a price tag.

t: 拆掉圣西罗，再卖一次感情
te: Tear Down San Siro, Sell the Feeling
a: 先拆掉记忆，再把记忆做成卖点。
ae: First demolish the memory, then sell it back as a feeling.

t: 立法通过了，工会还没进门
te: The Law Passed. The Union Is Still Outside the Door.
a: 权利写进法条那一刻，暴力只挪了半步
ae: Rights on paper move violence by half a step.

t: 一个强奸犯替法拉奇挡人群
te: A Rapist Walked Beside Farage
a: 安保外包是共谋的防火墙，没人负责就是所有人负责。
ae: Outsourced vetting is the firewall of complicity: nobody responsible means everybody is.

t: 肥胖不是意志力问题
te: Obesity Is Not a Willpower Problem
a: 把结构暴力说成个人懒惰，是元暴力的标准动作
ae: Calling structural violence personal laziness is meta-violence's standard move

t: 他骂了移民政策，但没算清自己站哪边
te: He Called Immigration Panic Un-British. He Didn't Ask Who Owns 'British'
a: 一个说'这不英国'的人，先得回答谁定义了英国
ae: Calling something 'not British' hands the definition of British to the people who fear you

t: 赛程表上的天气，不是谁的处境
te: The Weather on the Schedule Is Nobody's Predicament
a: 冷天的代价被写进赛程，但没人问谁在付
ae: The cold got scheduled; nobody asked who pays for it

t: 买地的是信托，种地的是谁
te: They Bought the Land. Who Gets to Farm It?
a: 三千万买下的不是荒野，是解释权
ae: Thirty million bought the land. It also bought the right to decide what the land is for.

t: 用行政命令制造沉默
te: Silencing by Decree
a: 禁令不针对言论，它针对的是解释权
ae: The ban doesn't target speech. It targets who gets to interpret.

t: 钱能买票，但买不动三十年的空
te: Money Buys Ads, Not Thirty Years
a: 选举的定价权在出钱的人手里，不在投票的人手里。
ae: The power to price an election belongs to those who pay, not those who vote.

t: 十八年没铺一寸轨，先铺了夜总会
te: Eighteen Years, Not One Rail, But a Nightclub
a: 暴力不只是钱不见了，是尺子被换了。
ae: The violence isn't the missing money. It's the swapped ruler.

t: 换个人坐那把椅子
te: Just Find Someone to Sit in the Chair
a: 没有候选人，只有候选人的位置
ae: No candidate, only a candidate-shaped seat

t: 把十岁的强奸做成三十秒广告
te: A Ten-Year-Old's Rape, Cut to Thirty Seconds
a: 他没有撒谎，他只是把受害者的身体重新定价成选票。
ae: He didn't lie. He repriced a survivor's body into votes.

t: 空椅子不是反腐成绩单
te: Empty Chairs Are Not an Anti-Corruption Scorecard
a: 换尺子不换能力，反腐也一样。
ae: Change the ruler, keep the ability. Anti-corruption works the same way.

t: 四百二十镑的牙刷，卖的是你的判断力
te: A £420 Toothbrush That Sells Your Judgment
a: 贵不是问题，让你替它省钱才是
ae: The price isn't the scandal. The consumables are.

t: 预测市场停摆一小时
te: One Hour Off the Board
a: 赌局可以暂停，赌徒的账要照付
ae: The betting can pause; the bettors still get paid.

t: 骗局卖的不是书，是你的渴望
te: The Scam Sells Your Hunger, Not Your Book
a: 骗局最锋利的地方，是让你自己交出判断力
ae: A scam's sharpest edge is making you hand over your own judgment

t: 婚姻是绞索，不是浪漫
te: Marriage Is a Noose, Not a Romance
a: 一部小说被搬上舞台，最动人的部分还是婚姻的窒息感
ae: The most moving part of this great novel is still the suffocation of marriage

t: 中古家具变贵，品味就换代
te: When Good Design Gets Priced Out, Taste Changes Hands
a: 当一件设计贵到只有某些人买得起，它就从品味变成了筛子。
ae: Once a design gets too expensive for most people, taste stops being taste and becomes a filter.

t: 挂毯上的红裙与真正的入侵
te: Red Petticoats on the Wall
a: 女人把裙子挂上墙，历史就把她们写成风景。
ae: Women hung their skirts on a wall, and history hung them as scenery.

t: 狂欢里谁在数钱
te: Who Was Counting the Money at the Party
a: 一场派对的记忆被装进空掉的夜店，门票另算
ae: A scene's memory gets boxed in a dead club, admission extra

t: 拉丁语没死，是老师赢了
te: Latin Didn't Die. The Teacher Won.
a: 一个老师把课本换成小熊维尼，两个学生的人生就改了
ae: One teacher swapped the textbook for Winnie-the-Pooh, and two lives changed.

t: 两亿五的冻结，谁的损失
te: $2.5bn Frozen, Whose Loss
a: 一笔钱被冻住了，但谁在付代价没人说。
ae: The money is frozen. Who pays is not in the story.

t: 他救了人，赛道没救人
te: He Saved a Man. The Track Didn't.
a: 一个人冲进火里，四分钟没人来
ae: One man ran into the fire. Help took four minutes.

t: 一个演员死了，悼词里全是他的立场
te: An Actor Died, and the Eulogies Are All About His Politics
a: 他被记住的不只是台词，还有他投过的票
ae: He is remembered not only for his lines, but for how he voted

t: 把厌女送进公共卫生科
te: Send Misogyny to the Public Health Clinic
a: 把商业模式说成流行病，是给共谋者换一件白大褂。
ae: Calling a business model an epidemic is just handing the co-conspirators a lab coat.

t: 福利账单砍不动，刀就落到别处
te: The Welfare Bill Survives; the Knife Moves Elsewhere
a: 不砍福利不是仁慈，是换个地方砍。
ae: Not cutting welfare isn't mercy. It's cutting somewhere quieter.

t: 一个演员的死，被写成了颂词
te: An Actor's Death, Written as a Eulogy
a: 讣告里没有一句提到他演过什么角色给谁定价
ae: The obituary never says which narratives his face made legitimate

t: 囤货清单是一张阶级地图
te: The Stockpile List Is a Class Map
a: 能囤三天物资的人，才有资格被建议囤三天物资
ae: Only those who can afford three days of supplies are told to stock three days of supplies.

t: 封口不是封口，是统一口径
te: Not a Gag, Just a Single Script
a: 不让部长说话，是为了让所有人说同一句话
ae: Silencing the cabinet means making everyone say the same thing

t: 折现率就是杀人许可证
te: The Discount Rate Is a License to Kill
a: 给未来打折，就是给死亡定价。
ae: Discounting the future is pricing death.

t: 球迷看球，俱乐部收租
te: Who Gets to Say How a Match Is Watched
a: 谁有权规定一场球该被怎样体验，谁就在定价。
ae: Whoever defines how a game should be experienced is the one pricing it.

t: 一支球队烂到底，城市还得掏钱
te: A Bad Team, a Bigger Bill
a: 球场上输的是比赛，谈判桌上赢的是补贴。
ae: They lose on the pitch and win at the negotiating table.

t: 法庭上发抖的是专家，不是暴力
te: The Expert's Hands Shake, Not the Violence
a: 证据再硬，解释权还在别人手里
ae: Evidence is hard; the power to mean it belongs to someone else.

t: 监狱装不下人，就重新定义坐牢
te: When Prisons Overflow, Redefine Prison
a: 换尺子不换能力，监狱危机的解法是改算术
ae: Changing the ruler is not changing the capacity.

t: 美人计是一门生意
te: A Beauty Contest Was Her Audition
a: 她的悼词写的是美貌，不是演技
ae: Her obituary remembers the face, not the actress.

t: 把厕所变成外交辞令
te: Toilets as Diplomatic Language
a: 用马桶回应侮辱，是公关，不是权力翻转
ae: Answering an insult with toilets is PR, not a transfer of power.

t: 一封被送错地方的信
te: A Letter Delivered to the Wrong Desk
a: 警方把指控交给了被指控者的家属，而不是交给执法机关。
ae: Police handed the allegations to the accused's family, not to law enforcement.

t: 74 Spills, Same as Last Year, Bonuses Intact
a: Privatisation sold the rivers; the bill goes to whoever pays the water rate
